```{r projection-funding}
    base_pop <- base_pop * 1000
  }

  # Health spending from all sources: government spending plus the other sources at their
  # latest level within ten years
  other <- own_fin |>
    filter(year <= base_year, year >= base_year - 10, che_pc_usd >= gghed_pc_usd) |>
    slice_max(year, n = 1)
  FUND$che <- NULL
  if (nrow(other) > 0) {
    FUND$che <- list(value = base_ghe + (other$che_pc_usd - other$gghed_pc_usd), year = other$year)
  }
  gdp <- fin |>
    filter(iso3 == ISO, code == "gdp_pc_usd", year <= base_year) |>
    slice_max(year, n = 1)
  FUND$gdp <- if (nrow(gdp) > 0) list(value = gdp$value, year = gdp$year) else NULL
  FUND$share0 <- PROJ$share$base
  FUND$capped <- PROJ$share$capped
  FUND$ceiling <- PROJ$share$ceiling
  # the first year's rise of the share, for the second scenario card
  share_at_start <- PROJ$share$at[as.character(PROJ$start)]
  share_a_year_later <- PROJ$share$at[as.character(PROJ$start + 1)]
  first_step <- unname(share_a_year_later - share_at_start)
  FUND$step <- if (length(first_step) > 0 && is.finite(first_step)) first_step else NA_real_

  # Each horizon and scenario: the extra spending a year, the deaths associated with it
  # (elasticity -0.13, other sources held) and the value of those lives at full income
  rows <- PROJ$rows |>
    filter(h %in% HORIZONS) |>
    select(h, year, trend, priority) |>
    pivot_longer(c(trend, priority), names_to = "scenario", values_to = "ghe") |>
    mutate(
      un_pop = un_country$population[match(year, un_country$year)],
      pop = ifelse(
        is.finite(un_pop) & is.finite(base_pop) & is.finite(un_pop_base) & un_pop_base > 0,
        base_pop * (un_pop / un_pop_base),
        if (is.finite(base_pop)) base_pop else un_pop
      ),
      deaths = un_country$deaths[match(year, un_country$year)],
      value_full = un_country$value_full[match(year, un_country$year)],
      dg = ghe - base_ghe,
      extra = dg * pop,
      share = ifelse(scenario == "trend", FUND$share0, PROJ$share$at[as.character(year)])
    )
  rows$averted <- NA_real_
  rows$full <- NA_real_
  if (!is.null(FUND$che)) {
    che <- FUND$che$value
    ok <- is.finite(rows$deaths) & che + rows$dg > 0
    rows$averted[ok] <- rows$deaths[ok] * (1 - ((che + rows$dg[ok]) / che)^(-0.13))
    if (!is.null(FUND$gdp)) {
      rows$full <- rows$averted * rows$value_full * FUND$gdp$value
    }
  }
  FUND$rows <- rows
  FUND$last <- filter(rows, h == max(h))
  FUND$health_ready <- any(is.finite(FUND$last$averted))
  FUND$value_ready <- any(is.finite(FUND$last$full))
}
```

## The four direction panels

We draw spending as an index, window start = 100, and calculate its median from the members' own indices, so the median line ends where the median growth rate does; a median of levels could fall while the typical country's spending rose. We show the outcomes as levels.

```{r direction-panels}
# Spending as an index (window start = 100, each country on its own start), and three outcome
# levels, every country and year of the window
spend_index <- gov |>
  filter(year >= window_start, year <= window_end) |>
  group_by(iso3) |>
  mutate(value = 100 * usd / first(usd[year == window_start])) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(iso3, panel = "spend", year, value)
panel_data <- outc |>
  filter(id %in% c("ncd", "u5", "uhc"), year >= window_start, year <= window_end) |>
  transmute(iso3, panel = id, year, value) |>
  bind_rows(spend_index) |>
  filter(is.finite(value))

# the country's line and the median of the members' values, year by year
own_panels <- panel_data |>
  filter(iso3 == ISO) |>
  select(panel, year, country = value)
median_panels <- panel_data |>
  filter(iso3 %in% INC_MEMBERS) |>
  group_by(panel, year) |>
  summarise(median = peer_median(value))
PANELS <- expand_grid(panel = c("spend", "ncd", "u5", "uhc"), year = window_start:window_end) |>
  left_join(own_panels, by = c("panel", "year")) |>
  left_join(median_panels, by = c("panel", "year"))

# the spending levels behind the index, for the slide's sentence
own_gov <- filter(gov, iso3 == ISO)
spend_levels <- c(
  from = own_gov$usd[own_gov$year == window_start][1],
  to = own_gov$usd[own_gov$year == window_end][1]
)
```

# The slides

For each slide, we keep the deck's title and question, add a short note on what it shows and how to read it, then use one chunk to compute every printed number as a table in the deck's format and draw the main figure.

## Slide 1. Cover

The cover names `r NAME`, the country's income group and region, and a reference year: the latest year at or before 2023 when all four financing shares (government, out of pocket, other domestic private, external) are published, none is negative or above 100, and the shares total 100 within 3 points. We count a private residual between -0.5 and 0 as zero. We use the deck's photograph credit.

```{r slide-01-cover}
# The reference year: the latest year with all four shares of current health spending
# published (government, out of pocket, other domestic private, external), none negative or
# above 100, and together within 3 points of 100
negative_residual_years <- flags |>
  filter(iso3 == ISO, flag == "private_residual_negative") |>
  pull(year)
cover <- own_fin |>
  filter(year <= MAX_YEAR) |>
  transmute(
    year,
    gov = gghed_che,
    oop = oops_che,
    ext = ext_che,
    # other domestic private: as published, else private less out of pocket, else what the
    # other three leave
    other = case_when(
      is.finite(other_pvtd_che) ~ other_pvtd_che,
      is.finite(pvtd_che) & is.finite(oops_che) ~ pvtd_che - oops_che,
      is.finite(gghed_che) & is.finite(oops_che) & is.finite(ext_che) ~
        100 - gghed_che - oops_che - ext_che
    ),
    # a residual between -0.5 and 0 counts as zero
    other = ifelse(other < 0 & other >= -0.5, 0, other)
  ) |>
  filter(is.finite(gov), is.finite(oop), is.finite(other), is.finite(ext)) |>
  mutate(total = gov + oop + other + ext) |>
  filter(pmin(gov, oop, other, ext) >= 0, pmax(gov, oop, other, ext) <= 100) |>
  filter(abs(total - 100) <= 3, !year %in% negative_residual_years) |>
  arrange(desc(year))
REF_YEAR <- if (nrow(cover) > 0) cover$year[1] else NA

out <- c(
  "Country" = NAME,
  "Income group" = INC_LABEL,
  "Region" = REG,
  "Reference year" = paste("Reference year", REF_YEAR)
)
credit <- filter(credits, iso3 == ISO)
if (nrow(credit) > 0) {
  out["Cover photo"] <- paste0(
    "Cover photo: ", credit$artist, ", ", credit$licence, ", via Wikimedia Commons."
  )
}
slide_values[[1]] <- out
knitr::kable(tibble::enframe(slide_values[[1]], name = "What the slide prints", value = "Value"))
```

## Slide 2. Contents

The contents list the slides in four groups (fiscal size and trend, health spending efficiency, health budget execution, fiscal space projection) and the annex, each numbered by its position. A country without local-currency data keeps US$ on its money slides and loses the six annex copies, so its deck has 16 slides instead of 22.

```{r slide-02-contents}
# the positions of the fourteen main slides; the annex copies follow when there is local
# currency
POS <- c(
  q09 = 3, a3 = 4, q01 = 5, q02 = 6, q03 = 7, q04 = 8, q05 = 9, q06 = 10, q07 = 11, q08 = 12,
  bs = 13, q10 = 14, q11 = 15, a1 = 16
)
TITLES <- c(
  q09 = "The decomposition of government health spending",
  a3 = "What drove the change in government health spending?",
  q01 = "Does the country achieve better health for its spending?",
  q02 = "Does the country achieve stronger financial protection for its spending?",
  q03 = "Are financing and performance moving in the right direction?",
  q04 = "Do health budgets translate into services?",
  q05 = "Does the country have the health workforce it needs?",
  q06 = "Are essential medicines available, and who pays for them?",
  q07 = "Does funding reach the services and populations with the greatest need?",
  q08 = "Do pooling and purchasing arrangements support the right care?",
  bs = "What is health budget space?",
  q10 = "What fiscal space can growth and health prioritisation create?",
  q11 = "How much more funding is needed, and what would it buy?",
  a1 = "Annex A1: What is the main performance gap: health, financial protection, or both?"
)
N_SLIDES <- if (LCU_MAIN) 22 else 16
contents <- data.frame(Slide = c(1, 2, POS), Title = c("Cover", "Contents", TITLES))
knitr::kable(contents, row.names = FALSE)

out <- setNames(paste(POS, TITLES), paste("Row", POS))
if (LCU_MAIN) {
  annex_row <- "17 Annex A2 to A7: slides 3, 5, 6, 8, 14 and 15 at market exchange rates, US$"
  out["Annex row"] <- annex_row
}
slide_values[[2]] <- out
knitr::kable(tibble::enframe(slide_values[[2]], name = "What the slide prints", value = "Value"))
```

## Slide 3. The decomposition of government health spending

*What are the binding constraints to increasing government health spending?*

We express government health spending per person in `r if (Q09$ready) Q09$year else "its latest complete year"` as the product of four steps, each compared with the `r ADJ` median for the same year: GDP per person, revenue as a share of GDP, spending per unit of revenue, and health's share of government spending. We print GDP per person and the result in `r CUR_NAME` at 2023 prices and compare them with the median in PPP, since national-currency levels cannot be compared across countries; the three budget steps are ratios and need no conversion. We print steps at two decimals, or the fiscal stance at three when two decimals would not multiply back to the printed result. The box names the primary fiscal constraint and what moving it to the median would be worth, all else held. To read it, a fiscal stance above 1 means part of spending is financed by borrowing; a step at the median is a distance from peers, not a target.

```{r slide-03-decomposition}
# We build slide 3 in local currency at 2023 prices, and the same slide in US$ for annex A2
# (slide 17). A country without a 2023 rate has slide 3 in US$ and no annex copy.
STEP_NAME <- c(
  rev = "Revenue, % of GDP",
  stance = "Fiscal stance (spending per unit of revenue)",
  spend = "Government spending, % of GDP",
  priority = "Health, % of government spending"
)
STEP_LABEL <- c(
  base = "GDP per person",
  rev = "Revenue, % of GDP",
  stance = "Spending per unit of revenue",
  spend = "Government spending, % of GDP",
  priority = "Health, % of government spending"
)
# the wording of the lead for each kind of binding constraint
CONSTRAINT_OPENING <- c(
  rev = "Revenue mobilisation",
  stance = "Fiscal stance",
  spend = "The size of government spending"
)
CONSTRAINT_SUBJECT <- c(
  rev = "revenue was ",
  stance = "spending was ",
  spend = "government spending was "
)
CONSTRAINT_UNIT <- c(rev = " of GDP", stance = " times revenue", spend = " of GDP")

SLIDE3 <- list()
versions <- if (LCU_MAIN) c("main", "annex") else "main"
for (version in versions) {
  lcu <- version == "main" && LCU_MAIN
  currency <- if (lcu) "local" else "US$"
  if (!Q09$ready) {
    message_text <- paste(
      "Income, government spending and its health share are not all published for one common",
      "year, so the constraints cannot be identified."
    )
    SLIDE3[[version]] <- list(values = c("Message" = message_text))
    next
  }
  identity_year <- Q09$year
  steps <- Q09$steps
  rate <- to_lcu$factor[match(identity_year, to_lcu$year)] # US$ of that year to local currency
  ghe_per_person <- if (lcu) Q09$ghe * rate else Q09$ghe
  gdp <- if (lcu) steps$value[1] * rate else steps$value[1]
  gdp_median <- if (lcu) steps$median[1] * rate else steps$median[1]

  # The printed operands must multiply to the printed result, as on the deck: the steps at two
  # decimals, else the fiscal stance at three. GDP per person enters as printed: to the unit,
  # or with three significant figures when it is written in millions or more.
  word_unit <- case_when(
    !lcu ~ 1,
    abs(gdp) >= 1e12 ~ 1e12,
    abs(gdp) >= 1e9 ~ 1e9,
    abs(gdp) >= 1e6 ~ 1e6,
    TRUE ~ 1
  )
  if (word_unit > 1) {
    gdp_in_words <- gdp / word_unit
    word_digits <- case_when(abs(gdp_in_words) >= 100 ~ 0, abs(gdp_in_words) >= 10 ~ 1, TRUE ~ 2)
    gdp_printed <- round(gdp_in_words, word_digits) * word_unit
  } else {
    gdp_printed <- round(gdp)
  }
  product_2 <- gdp_printed
  product_3 <- gdp_printed
  for (i in 2:nrow(steps)) {
    if (steps$step[i] == "stance") {
      product_2 <- product_2 * round(steps$value[i], 2)
      product_3 <- product_3 * round(steps$value[i], 3)
    } else {
      product_2 <- product_2 * (round(steps$value[i], 2) / 100)
      product_3 <- product_3 * (round(steps$value[i], 2) / 100)
    }
  }
  if (lcu) {
    result <- fmt_money(ghe_per_person)
    text_2 <- fmt_money(product_2)
    text_3 <- fmt_money(product_3)
  } else {
    # in US$ the deck prints two decimals below US$10 and whole dollars above
    result <- num(ghe_per_person, ifelse(ghe_per_person < 10, 2, 0), prefix = "US$")
    text_2 <- num(product_2, ifelse(product_2 < 10, 2, 0), prefix = "US$")
    text_3 <- num(product_3, ifelse(product_3 < 10, 2, 0), prefix = "US$")
  }
  stance_digits <- if (text_2 != result && text_3 == result) 3 else 2

  # Each step and its median as printed: GDP per person in money, the fiscal stance as a
  # number, the other steps in %
  is_stance <- steps$step == "stance"
  steps$value_text <- ifelse(
    is_stance,
    num(steps$value, stance_digits),
    num(steps$value, 2, suffix = "%")
  )
  steps$median_text <- ifelse(
    is_stance,
    num(steps$median, stance_digits),
    num(steps$median, 2, suffix = "%")
  )
  if (lcu) {
    steps$value_text[1] <- fmt_money(gdp, exact = TRUE)
    steps$median_text[1] <- fmt_money(gdp_median, exact = TRUE)
  } else {
    steps$value_text[1] <- num(gdp, 0, prefix = "US$")
    steps$median_text[1] <- num(gdp_median, 0, prefix = "US$")
  }

  # GDP per person against its median: in PPP on the local-currency slide, in US$ otherwise
  if (lcu && isTRUE(is.finite(Q09$gdp_ppp_ratio))) {
    gdp_versus <- paste0(num(Q09$gdp_ppp_ratio, 2), NB, "× the median, PPP")
  } else if (lcu) {
    gdp_versus <- "PPP median not available"
  } else if (Q09$peer_ok && is.finite(steps$median[1])) {
    gdp_versus <- paste("Median", steps$median_text[1])
  } else {
    gdp_versus <- "Median not available"
  }
  out <- c()
  out["GDP per person"] <- steps$value_text[1]
  out["GDP per person against the median"] <- gdp_versus
  for (i in 2:nrow(steps)) {
    name <- STEP_NAME[[steps$step[i]]]
    has_median <- Q09$peer_ok && is.finite(steps$median[i])
    out[name] <- steps$value_text[i]
    out[paste(name, "against the median")] <- if (has_median) {
      paste("Median", steps$median_text[i])
    } else {
      "Median not available"
    }
  }

  # the result against its median, in the same way
  if (lcu && isTRUE(is.finite(Q09$ghe_ppp_ratio))) {
    ghe_versus <- paste0(num(Q09$ghe_ppp_ratio, 2), NB, "× the median, PPP")
  } else if (lcu) {
    ghe_versus <- "PPP median not available"
  } else if (Q09$peer_ok && is.finite(Q09$peer_med)) {
    peer_digits <- ifelse(Q09$peer_med < 10, 2, 0)
    ghe_versus <- paste("Median", num(Q09$peer_med, peer_digits, prefix = "US$"))
  } else {
    ghe_versus <- "Median not available"
  }
  out["Government health spending per person"] <- result
  out["Spending against the median"] <- ghe_versus
  if (lcu) {
    at_prices <- if (identity_year != BASE) paste0(" at ", BASE, " prices") else ""
    out["Year and currency"] <- paste0(
      identity_year, ", ", CUR_NAME, at_prices, " (", RATE_TEXT, ", WHO GHED)"
    )
  } else {
    out["Year and currency"] <- paste0(identity_year, ", current US$")
  }
  out["Income-group countries"] <- paste0("countries (", Q09$N, ")")
  if (text_2 != result && text_3 != result && is.finite(product_2)) {
    out["Rounded product"] <- paste0(
      "The rounded figures multiply to ", text_2, "; the exact product is ", result, "."
    )
  }

  # The lead names the binding step with its figures when the sentence still fits two lines
  short_ghe <- fmt_money(ghe_per_person, currency)
  binding <- Q09$binding
  if (!Q09$peer_ok) {
    lead <- paste0(
      "In ", identity_year, ", government health spending was ", short_ghe, " per person; the ",
      ADJ, " medians do not meet the reporting rule for ", identity_year,
      ", so no constraint can be named."
    )
  } else if (is.na(binding)) {
    lead <- paste0(
      "No fiscal step is more than 5% below the ", ADJ, " median in ", identity_year,
      "; scope for additional health reprioritisation is assessed separately through",
      " historical and peer benchmarking."
    )
  } else {
    binding_step <- steps[steps$step == binding, ]
    opening <- paste0(CONSTRAINT_OPENING[[binding]], " emerges as the primary fiscal constraint")
    figures <- paste0(
      CONSTRAINT_SUBJECT[[binding]], "<b>", binding_step$value_text, "</b>",
      CONSTRAINT_UNIT[[binding]], " in ", identity_year, " against ", AN_ADJ, " ", ADJ,
      " median of <b>", binding_step$median_text, "</b>"
    )
    long <- paste0(
      opening, ": ", figures, ". Scope for additional health reprioritisation is assessed",
      " separately through historical and peer benchmarking."
    )
    shorter <- paste0(opening, ": ", figures, ". Health reprioritisation is assessed separately.")
    shortest <- paste0(
      opening, "; scope for additional health reprioritisation is assessed separately through",
      " historical and peer benchmarking."
    )
    # we take the longest wording that fits two lines
    if (lead_width(long) <= LEAD_LIMIT) {
      lead <- long
    } else if (lead_width(shorter) <= LEAD_LIMIT) {
      lead <- shorter
    } else {
      lead <- shortest
    }
    lead <- gsub("<[^>]+>", "", lead) # the bold marks only served the width estimate
  }
  out["Lead"] <- lead

  if (Q09$peer_ok && !is.na(binding)) {
    cf <- steps$cf[steps$step == binding]
    cf_text <- if (lcu) fmt_money(cf * rate) else fmt_money(cf, "US$")
    out["Binding step at its median"] <- paste0(
      "would increase to ", cf_text, " per capita, compared with ", short_ghe
    )
  } else if (Q09$peer_ok) {
    which_steps <- if (Q09$split) "Revenue and the fiscal stance are" else "Government spending is"
    out["No fiscal constraint"] <- paste0(
      which_steps, " within 5% of the ", ADJ, " median or above it"
    )
  }
  priority_step <- steps[steps$step == "priority", ]
  if (Q09$peer_ok && is.finite(priority_step$value) && is.finite(priority_step$median)) {
    out["Health share against the median"] <- paste0(
      "Health's share (", priority_step$value_text, ") is ", Q09$prio_rel, " the ", ADJ,
      " median (", priority_step$median_text, ")"
    )
  }

  # The figure: each step against its median as a ratio (1 = the median; below 0.95 a
  # shortfall)
  p <- NULL
  if (Q09$peer_ok) {
    bars <- data.frame(
      step = STEP_LABEL[steps$step],
      ratio = steps$ratio,
      kind = ifelse(steps$step %in% binding, "Binding constraint", "Step")
    )
    if (lcu) {
      bars$ratio[1] <- Q09$gdp_ppp_ratio
    }
    result_bar <- data.frame(
      step = "Government health spending per person",
      kind = "Result",
      ratio = if (lcu) Q09$ghe_ppp_ratio else Q09$ghe / Q09$peer_med
    )
    bars <- rbind(bars, result_bar)
    bars$step <- factor(bars$step, levels = rev(bars$step))
    p <- ggplot(bars, aes(ratio, step, fill = kind)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.6) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour = WB[["ink"]], linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0.95, colour = WB[["rust"]], linetype = "dotted") +
      geom_text(aes(label = num(ratio, 2)), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.6, colour = WB[["ink"]]) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(
        "Binding constraint" = WB[["rust"]],
        Step = WB[["teal"]],
        Result = WB[["dark"]]
      )) +
      scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Each step against the ", ADJ, " median, ", identity_year),
        subtitle = if (lcu) {
          "Ratio to the median; GDP and spending per person compared in PPP"
        } else {
          "Ratio to the median, current US$"
        },
        x = "Country value / income-group median",
        y = NULL
      ) +
      theme_deck()
  }
  SLIDE3[[version]] <- list(values = out, plot = p)
}

values <- SLIDE3$main$values
if (Q09$ready && !is.null(FALLBACK_NOTE)) {
  values["Currency note"] <- FALLBACK_NOTE
}
slide_values[[3]] <- values
knitr::kable(tibble::enframe(slide_values[[3]], name = "What the slide prints", value = "Value"))
if (!is.null(SLIDE3$main$plot)) print(SLIDE3$main$plot)
```

## Slide 4. What drove the change in government health spending?

Over `r TR$window$y0` to `r TR$window$y1`, we split the change in `r poss(SHORT)` real government health spending per person into the part that came from economic growth, the part that came from the size of the government budget relative to GDP, and the part that came from health's share of that budget. In log points, the three add up exactly to the total, so we can read the chart as a sum: each bar shows how much of the yearly change that part accounted for. The grey bars are the `r ADJ` medians of each part, taken separately, so they need not add up. The small chart compares the two halves of the window; a change of at least 1.5 points a year between them reads as faster or slower growth. We show economic growth for context only: it is not a lever a health ministry holds.

```{r slide-04-drivers}
country_change <- TR$dec
median_change <- TR$median
out <- c()
if (is.null(country_change)) {
  # Without the split we say why, with total health spending when it is published
  che <- TR$che
  if (!is.null(che)) {
    direction <- if (che$value >= 0) "rose" else "fell"
    out["Message"] <- paste0(
      "Government health spending cannot be split into its parts for this profile; health",
      " spending per person from all sources ", direction, " ", num(abs(che$value), 1),
      "% a year after inflation from ", window_start, " to ", window_end, "."
    )
  } else {
    out["Message"] <- paste(
      "Government health spending, GDP and the government budget are not all published at",
      "constant prices for this profile, so the change cannot be split into its parts."
    )
  }
} else {
  out["Window"] <- paste("From", window_start, "to", window_end)
  total_direction <- if (country_change[["total"]] >= 0) "rose " else "fell "
  total_text <- num(abs(country_change[["total"]]), 1)
  out["Total, a year"] <- paste0(total_direction, total_text, "% a year")
  # the three parts in the lead, then every bar with its median
  part <- c(
    income = "the economy",
    pie = "the budget's share of GDP",
    slice = "health's share of the budget"
  )
  for (k in names(part)) {
    direction <- if (country_change[[k]] >= 0) "grew" else "fell"
    change_text <- num(abs(country_change[[k]]), 1, suffix = "%")
    out[paste("Lead,", part[[k]])] <- paste0(part[[k]], " ", direction, " ", change_text)
  }
  bar <- c(
    income = "economy",
    pie = "government budget",
    slice = "health priority",
    total = "government health spending"
  )
  for (k in names(bar)) {
    out[paste("Bar,", bar[[k]])] <- num(country_change[[k]], 1, suffix = "%", plus = TRUE)
    if (is.finite(median_change[[k]])) {
      out[paste("Median bar,", bar[[k]])] <- num(median_change[[k]], 1, suffix = "%", plus = TRUE)
    }
  }
  out["Median countries"] <- paste0("median (", TR$median_n, " countries)")

  # the part furthest from its median
  gaps <- country_change[names(part)] - median_change[names(part)]
  if (any(is.finite(gaps))) {
    k <- names(gaps)[which.max(abs(gaps))]
    out["Largest gap from the median"] <- paste0(
      num(country_change[[k]], 1, plus = TRUE), "% against ",
      num(median_change[[k]], 1, plus = TRUE), "% a year"
    )
  }

  # Growth in the two halves of the window: a change of 1.5 points a year or more reads as
  # faster or slower growth
  halves <- TR$halves
  if (!is.null(halves)) {
    first <- halves$first
    second <- halves$second
    trend <- case_when(
      first >= 0 & second < 0 ~ paste("Spending fell after", halves$mid),
      first < 0 & second >= 0 ~ paste("Spending recovered after", halves$mid),
      first < 0 & second < 0 ~ "Spending fell in both periods",
      second - first >= 1.5 ~ paste("Growth picked up after", halves$mid),
      second - first <= -1.5 ~ paste("Growth slowed after", halves$mid),
      TRUE ~ "Growth was similar in both periods"
    )
    first_text <- num(first, 1, suffix = "%", plus = TRUE)
    second_text <- num(second, 1, suffix = "%", plus = TRUE)
    out["The two periods"] <- paste0(trend, ", from ", first_text, " to ", second_text, " a year")
    out["First period, column"] <- first_text
    out["Second period, column"] <- second_text
    out["First period"] <- paste0(window_start, "-", halves$mid)
    out["Second period"] <- paste0(halves$mid, "-", window_end)
    out["Change between the periods"] <- num(second - first, 1, plus = TRUE)
  }
  if (!is.null(FALLBACK_NOTE)) {
    out["Currency note"] <- FALLBACK_NOTE
  }
}
slide_values[[4]] <- out
knitr::kable(tibble::enframe(slide_values[[4]], name = "What the slide prints", value = "Value"))

# The figure: each part's average change against the income-group median of that part
if (!is.null(country_change)) {
  rows <- c(
    income = "Economy\nGDP per person",
    pie = "Government budget\n% of GDP",
    slice = "Health priority\n% of government budget",
    total = "Government health\nspending per person"
  )
  median_label <- paste(ADJ_CAP, "median")
  bars <- rbind(
    data.frame(part = rows, who = SHORT, v = country_change[names(rows)]),
    data.frame(part = rows, who = median_label, v = median_change[names(rows)])
  )
  bars$part <- factor(bars$part, levels = rev(rows))
  bars$who <- factor(bars$who, levels = c(median_label, SHORT))
  bars$fill <- ifelse(bars$who == SHORT, ifelse(bars$v >= 0, "up", "down"), "median")
  ggplot(bars, aes(v, part, fill = fill, group = who)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = num(v, 1, suffix = "%", plus = TRUE), hjust = ifelse(v >= 0, -0.15, 1.15)),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(up = WB[["teal"]], down = WB[["rust"]], median = WB[["grey"]]),
      breaks = c("up", "down", "median"),
      labels = c(up = SHORT, down = paste(SHORT, "(fell)"), median = median_label)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.18)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Average change, % a year, ", window_start, " to ", window_end),
      subtitle = "Log points; the three parts add up to the total",
      x = "Average change, % a year",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_deck()
}
```

## Slide 5. Does the country achieve better health for its spending?

We plot every country's premature NCD mortality against its health spending per person in PPP international dollars in `r if (isTRUE(HEALTH_PPP$ready)) HEALTH_PPP$cyear else "the fit year"`; the dashed curve shows what countries typically show at each spending level. We mark `r SHORT` with its gap to that curve and name the four countries in its region that are closest in spending. The figure beside the chart combines premature NCD, child and maternal deaths into one health score. To read it, a dot below the curve has lower mortality than typical for its spending. We show an association across countries, not the effect of spending, and premature NCD mortality is a WHO estimate, modelled where deaths are not fully registered.

```{r slide-05-health-for-spending}
# How each measure is printed: decimals, a % sign, its name in the sentence, its unit and its
# axis title
MEASURE_FORMAT <- data.frame(
  id = c("ncd", "u5", "maternal", "uhc"),
  log_scale = c(FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE),
  dec = c(1, 1, 0, 0),
  pct = c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE),
  noun = c(
    "the risk of premature deaths from noncommunicable diseases (ages 30 to 70)",
    "under-five mortality",
    "maternal mortality",
    "the UHC service coverage index"
  ),
  per = c("%", "per 1,000 live births", "per 100,000 live births", "points"),
  axis = c(
    "Dying of an NCD at ages 30 to 70, %",
    "Under-five deaths per 1,000 births (log scale)",
    "Maternal deaths per 100,000 births (log scale)",
    "UHC service coverage index (0 to 100)"
  )
)

# We build slide 5 with spending in PPP, and the same slide in US$ for annex A3 (slide 18);
# without local currency there is the US$ slide only
SLIDE5 <- list()
versions <- if (LCU_MAIN) c("main", "annex") else "main"
for (version in versions) {
  ppp <- version == "main" && LCU_MAIN
  health_fit <- if (ppp) HEALTH_PPP else HEALTH_USD
  scatter <- health_fit$scatter
  if (!isTRUE(health_fit$ready) || is.null(scatter)) {
    message_text <- paste(
      "Health spending and health outcomes are not published for enough countries in the same",
      "year to make this comparison."
    )
    SLIDE5[[version]] <- list(values = c("Message" = message_text))
    next
  }

  # The country's measures with their gap to the typical level in words: a ratio for the two
  # mortality rates on a log scale ("23% lower than"), a difference in points for the others
  own_measures <- health_fit$country$components |>
    left_join(MEASURE_FORMAT, by = "id") |>
    arrange(match(id, MEASURE_FORMAT$id)) |>
    mutate(
      ratio_words = paste0(
        num(abs(ratio - 1) * 100, 0), "% ", ifelse(ratio < 1, "lower than", "higher than")
      ),
      points_words = paste(num(abs(gap), 1), "points", ifelse(gap >= 0, "above", "below")),
      gap_label = ifelse(log_scale, ratio_words, points_words),
      percentage_words = paste(
        num(abs(gap), 1), "percentage points", ifelse(gap >= 0, "higher than", "lower than")
      ),
      gap_words = ifelse(log_scale | !pct, gap_label, percentage_words)
    )

  chart_notes <- c(
    "Axis year" = paste0(if (ppp) "(PPP, log scale), " else "(log scale), ", scatter$year),
    "Countries in the fit" = paste0("least-squares fit across ", scatter$n, " countries"),
    "Figure year" = paste0("Each dot is a country, ", scatter$year)
  )
  if (is.null(scatter$country)) {
    # a country without the charted measure: the chart of the other countries, and why
    no_comparison <- paste(
      "Health spending and health outcomes are not both published for the same year, so",
      "results cannot be compared with what countries at this spending level typically show."
    )
    out <- c("Lead" = no_comparison, chart_notes)
  } else {
    charted <- own_measures[own_measures$id == scatter$measure, ]
    unit_text <- case_when(
      charted$pct ~ "%",
      charted$id == "uhc" ~ "",
      TRUE ~ paste0(" ", sub(" live births", "", charted$per))
    )
    value <- paste0(num(charted$value, charted$dec), unit_text)
    typical <- paste0(num(charted$expected, charted$dec), if (charted$pct) "%" else "")
    against <- if (identical(charted$verdict, "close")) {
      paste0("close to the ", typical, " typical")
    } else {
      paste0(charted$gap_words, " the ", typical, " typical")
    }
    spending <- fmt_money(health_fit$country$spend, if (ppp) "Int$" else "US$")
    countries_note <- case_when(
      charted$pct & ppp ~ " (PPP)",
      charted$pct ~ "",
      ppp ~ paste0(" (PPP, ", scatter$n, " countries)"),
      TRUE ~ paste0(" (", scatter$n, " countries)")
    )
    out <- c()
    out["Lead"] <- paste0(
      "In ", charted$year, ", ", charted$noun, " was ", value, ", ", against,
      " of countries spending ",
      spending, " per person on health", countries_note, "."
    )
    out["Gap label on the chart"] <- paste(charted$gap_label, "typical")
    out <- c(out, chart_notes)
    if (nrow(health_fit$peers) > 0) {
      out["Comparators"] <- paste0("Dark dots: the ", nrow(health_fit$peers), " countries")
    }

    # The second sentence: coverage when it parts from the health score, else the weakest
    # outcome, else the comparators that score higher
    z <- health_fit$country$z
    coverage <- own_measures[own_measures$id == "uhc", ]
    scored_measures <- own_measures[own_measures$in_score & is.finite(own_measures$z), ]
    weakest <- scored_measures[which.min(scored_measures$z), ]
    coverage_parts <- nrow(coverage) > 0 && is.finite(coverage$z) && is.finite(z) &&
      abs(coverage$z - z) >= 1
    weakest_is_worse <- nrow(weakest) > 0 && identical(weakest$verdict, "worse") &&
      weakest$id != scatter$measure
    if (coverage_parts) {
      out["Coverage"] <- paste0(
        "the UHC index is ", num(coverage$value, 0), ", against ", num(coverage$expected, 0),
        " typical at this spending (", coverage$year, ")"
      )
    } else if (weakest_is_worse) {
      out["Weakest outcome"] <- paste0(
        weakest$gap_words, " the typical level (", weakest$year, ")"
      )
    } else if (nrow(health_fit$peers) > 0 && is.finite(z)) {
      scored_peers <- health_fit$peers[is.finite(health_fit$peers$z), ]
      if (nrow(scored_peers) > 0) {
        how_many <- if (any(scored_peers$z > z)) "Of the " else "None of the "
        out["Comparators scoring higher"] <- paste0(how_many, nrow(scored_peers), " countries")
      }
    }
  }

  # The figure: every country, the typical level at each spending level, the country's gap
  # and its four comparators
  charted_format <- MEASURE_FORMAT[MEASURE_FORMAT$id == scatter$measure, ]
  lowest <- min(scatter$points$x) * 0.9
  highest <- max(scatter$points$x) * 1.1
  spending_grid <- exp(seq(log(lowest), log(highest), length.out = 100))
  fitted_line <- scatter$fit$a + scatter$fit$b * log10(spending_grid)
  is_mortality <- scatter$measure %in% c("ncd", "u5", "maternal")
  curve <- data.frame(
    x = spending_grid,
    y = if (is_mortality) exp(fitted_line) else fitted_line
  )
  scatter_points <- mutate(scatter$points, peer = iso3 %in% health_fit$peers$iso)
  labels <- scatter_points |>
    filter(peer) |>
    transmute(x, y, label = countries$label[match(iso3, ISOS)], face = "plain")
  if (!is.null(scatter$country)) {
    own_gap_label <- own_measures$gap_label[own_measures$id == scatter$measure]
    own_label <- data.frame(
      x = health_fit$country$spend,
      y = scatter$country$value,
      label = paste0(SHORT, "\n", own_gap_label, " typical"),
      face = "bold"
    )
    labels <- bind_rows(labels, own_label)
  }
  noun <- charted_format$noun
  noun_capitalised <- paste0(toupper(substr(noun, 1, 1)), substring(noun, 2))
  x_title <- if (ppp) {
    "Health spending per person, current international $ (PPP, log scale)"
  } else {
    "Health spending per person, current US$ (log scale)"
  }
  p <- ggplot(scatter_points, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = peer, size = peer)) +
    geom_line(data = curve, linetype = "dashed", colour = WB[["ink"]]) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(`FALSE` = WB[["faint"]], `TRUE` = WB[["muted"]]),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_size_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 1.6, `TRUE` = 2.6), guide = "none") +
    scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma(accuracy = 1))
  if (charted_format$log_scale) {
    p <- p + scale_y_log10()
  }
  if (!is.null(scatter$country)) {
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "segment",
        x = health_fit$country$spend, xend = health_fit$country$spend,
        y = scatter$country$expected, yend = scatter$country$value,
        colour = WB[["teal"]], linewidth = 1
      ) +
      annotate(
        "point",
        x = health_fit$country$spend, y = scatter$country$value,
        colour = WB[["teal"]], size = 4
      )
  }
  p <- p +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = labels,
      aes(x, y, label = label, fontface = face),
      family = "Open Sans", size = 3.3, colour = WB[["dark"]],
      box.padding = 0.6, min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(noun_capitalised, ", ", scatter$year),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Dashed: the level typical at each spending level (", scatter$n, " countries)"
      ),
      x = x_title,
      y = charted_format$axis
    ) +
    theme_deck()
  SLIDE5[[version]] <- list(values = out, plot = p)
}

values <- SLIDE5$main$values

}

knitr::kable(tibble::enframe(slide_values[[5]], name = "What the slide prints", value = "Value"))
```

## Slide 6. Does the country achieve stronger financial protection for its spending?

Each dot shows a country's latest survey of financial hardship (SDG 3.8.2, 2025 definition) against its government health spending per person in the survey year, in constant 2023 PPP dollars. The dashed line shows the level typical at each spending level. `r if (is.finite(PROT_PPP$country$year)) paste0("For ", SHORT, " the latest survey is from ", PROT_PPP$country$year, ".") else paste0(SHORT, " has no survey of financial hardship in global data.")` To read it, a dot below the line has less hardship than countries spending the same, and the group median beside the chart pools each member's latest survey, so survey years differ. Low hardship can also mean people go without care, which global data do not measure, and an old survey may no longer describe the country.

```{r slide-06-financial-protection}
# A country with a survey paired at market exchange rates but no 2023 PPP conversion keeps
# the US$ comparison
NO_PPP_6 <- LCU_MAIN && !is.finite(PROT_PPP$country$spending) &&
  is.finite(PROT_USD$country$spending)

# We build slide 6 with spending in constant 2023 PPP dollars, and the same slide in constant
# 2023 US$ for annex A4 (slide 19)
SLIDE6 <- list()
versions <- if (LCU_MAIN) c("main", "annex") else "main"
for (version in versions) {
  ppp <- version == "main" && LCU_MAIN && !NO_PPP_6
  protection_fit <- if (ppp) PROT_PPP else PROT_USD
  peers <- if (ppp) HEALTH_PPP$peers$iso else HEALTH_USD$peers$iso
  own <- protection_fit$country
  oop <- protection_fit$oop
  out <- c()
  if (is.na(own$measure)) {
    no_survey <- "No household survey of financial hardship from health costs is published"
    if (!is.null(oop)) {
      out["Lead"] <- paste0(
        no_survey, "; out-of-pocket payments were ", num(oop$value, 0, suffix = "%"),
        " of health spending in ", oop$year, "."
      )
    } else {
      out["Lead"] <- paste0(no_survey, ".")
    }
  } else {
    what <- if (own$measure == "hardship") {
      "of people faced financial hardship from health costs"
    } else {
      "of people spent more than 10% of their budget on health"
    }
    share_text <- num(own$value, 1, suffix = "%")
    if (!is.finite(own$spending)) {
      out["Lead"] <- paste0(
        share_text, " ", what, " in ", own$year, "; government health spending is not",
        " published for that year, so no comparison is possible."
      )
    } else {
      if (ppp) {
        per <- paste0(fmt_money(own$spending, "Int$"), " per person, PPP")
      } else {
        per <- paste0(fmt_money(own$spending, "US$"), " per person")
      }
      comparison <- ""
      if (is.finite(own$expected)) {
        comparison <- paste0(
          ", against ", num(own$expected, 1, suffix = "%"),
          " typical at the same government health spending (", per, ")"
        )
      }
      out["Lead"] <- paste0(share_text, " ", what, " in ", own$year, comparison, ".")
      out["Country label"] <- paste0(", ", own$year)
      if (is.finite(own$expected)) {
        gap <- own$value - own$expected
        side <- if (gap <= 0) "below" else "above"
        out["Gap label"] <- paste(num(abs(gap), 1), "points", side, "typical")
      }
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(protection_fit$years)) {
    paired_years <- protection_fit$years
    out["Survey years"] <- paste0("latest survey (", paired_years[1], " to ", paired_years[2], ")")
  }
  if (!is.na(own$measure)) {
    group <- protection_fit$group
    if (is.finite(group$median)) {
      survey_years <- ""
      if (!is.null(group$years)) {
        survey_years <- paste0(", surveys ", group$years[1], " to ", group$years[2])
      }
      out["Group median"] <- paste0(
        "median is ", num(group$median, 1, suffix = "%"), " (latest survey of ", group$n,
        " of ", group$N, " countries", survey_years, ")"
      )
    } else {
      out["Group median"] <- paste0("give a group median (", group$n, " of ", group$N, ")")
    }

    # When hardship is not low, we flag an old survey; otherwise we set the out-of-pocket
    # share against its median
    hardship_is_low <- identical(own$verdict, "stronger") || (is.finite(own$value) && own$value < 5)
    if (own$measure == "hardship" && !hardship_is_low) {
      if (MAX_YEAR - own$year >= 5) {
        out["Old survey"] <- paste("The latest survey is from", own$year)
      } else if (!is.null(oop) && is.finite(oop$value)) {
        oop_versus <- ""
        if (is.finite(oop$median) && abs(oop$value - oop$median) < 2) {
          oop_versus <- paste0(", close to the ", ADJ, " median")
        } else if (is.finite(oop$median)) {
          oop_versus <- paste0("; the ", ADJ, " median is ", num(oop$median, 0, suffix = "%"))
        }
        out["Out of pocket"] <- paste0(
          "Out-of-pocket payments are ", num(oop$value, 0, suffix = "%"),
          " of health spending (", oop$year, ")", oop_versus
        )
      }
    }
  }

  # The figure: each country's latest survey against government spending in its year, and the
  # typical level
  p <- NULL
  if (!is.null(protection_fit$fit) && nrow(protection_fit$points) > 0) {
    scatter_points <- mutate(protection_fit$points, peer = iso %in% peers)
    lowest <- min(scatter_points$x) * 0.85
    highest <- max(scatter_points$x) * 1.15
    spending_grid <- exp(seq(log(lowest), log(highest), length.out = 100))
    fitted_line <- protection_fit$fit$a + protection_fit$fit$b * log10(spending_grid)
    curve <- data.frame(x = spending_grid, y = pmax(0, fitted_line))
    labels <- scatter_points |>
      filter(peer) |>
      transmute(x, y, label = countries$label[match(iso, ISOS)], face = "plain")
    if (is.finite(own$spending)) {
      gap_text <- ""
      if (is.finite(own$expected)) {
        side <- if (own$value <= own$expected) "below" else "above"
        gap_points <- num(abs(own$value - own$expected), 1)
        gap_text <- paste0("\n", gap_points, " points ", side, " typical")
      }
      own_label <- data.frame(
        x = own$spending,
        y = own$value,
        label = paste0(SHORT, ", ", own$year, gap_text),
        face = "bold"
      )
      labels <- bind_rows(labels, own_label)
    }
    x_title <- if (ppp) {
      "Government health spending per person, constant 2023 international $ (PPP, log scale)"
    } else {
      "Government health spending per person, constant 2023 US$ (log scale)"
    }
    y_title <- if (identical(own$measure, "cat10_oop")) {
      "Health spending over 10% of budget, % of people"
    } else {
      "Financial hardship, % of people"
    }
    p <- ggplot(scatter_points, aes(x, y)) +
      geom_point(aes(colour = peer, size = peer)) +
      geom_line(data = curve, linetype = "dashed", colour = WB[["ink"]]) +
      scale_colour_manual(
        values = c(`FALSE` = WB[["faint"]], `TRUE` = WB[["muted"]]),
        guide = "none"
      ) +
      scale_size_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 1.6, `TRUE` = 2.6), guide = "none") +
      scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma(accuracy = 1)) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)))
    if (is.finite(own$spending)) {
      p <- p +
        annotate(
          "segment",
          x = own$spending, xend = own$spending,
          y = own$expected, yend = own$value,
          colour = WB[["teal"]], linewidth = 1
        ) +
        annotate("point", x = own$spending, y = own$value, colour = WB[["teal"]], size = 4)
    }
    p <- p +
      geom_text_repel(
        data = labels,
        aes(x, y, label = label, fontface = face),
        family = "Open Sans", size = 3.3, colour = WB[["dark"]],
        box.padding = 0.6, min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Financial hardship against government health spending, latest survey per country",
        subtitle = "Dashed: the level typical at each spending level",
        x = x_title,
        y = y_title
      ) +
      theme_deck()
  }
  SLIDE6[[version]] <- list(values = out, plot = p)
}

values <- SLIDE6$main$values
if (!is.null(FALLBACK_NOTE)) {
  values["Currency note"] <- FALLBACK_NOTE
}
if (NO_PPP_6) {
  values["PPP note"] <- paste0(
    "Spending in constant 2023 US$: ", SHORT,
    " has no 2023 health spending in WHO GHED to convert to PPP."
  )
}
slide_values[[6]] <- values
knitr::kable(tibble::enframe(slide_values[[6]], name = "What the slide prints", value = "Value"))
if (!is.null(SLIDE6$main$plot)) print(SLIDE6$main$plot)
```

## Slide 7. Are financing and performance moving in the right direction?

We follow `r SHORT` and the `r ADJ` median year by year over the same window as slide 4 in four panels: government health spending as an index, premature NCD mortality, under-five mortality and the UHC service coverage index. The sentences beside them count measures where the country is better than the median in the latest year, describe whether each gap narrowed or widened, and compare the first and latest financial-hardship survey in the window. Outcomes respond to spending with a lag, so a decade of change does not show the reason for the change, and the premature NCD series ends in 2021.

```{r slide-07-direction}
out <- c()
# Spending growth over the window: government health spending when it splits into its parts,
# else health spending from all sources
growth <- NA
if (!is.null(TR$dec)) {
  growth <- TR$dec[["total"]]
  growth_median <- TR$median[["total"]]
  what <- "real government health spending per capita"
} else if (!is.null(TR$che)) {
  growth <- TR$che$value
  growth_median <- TR$che$median
  what <- "real health spending per capita from all sources"
}
if (is.na(growth)) {
  out["Lead"] <- paste0(
    "Government health spending per person is not published at constant prices for ",
    window_start, " to ", window_end, "."
  )
} else {
  direction <- if (growth >= 0) "increased" else "declined"
  versus_median <- ""
  if (is.finite(growth_median)) {
    median_direction <- if (growth_median >= 0) "increase" else "decline"
    versus_median <- paste0(
      ", compared with a median annual ", median_direction, " of ",
      num(abs(growth_median), 1), "% among ", ADJ, " countries"
    )
  }
  out["Lead"] <- paste0(
    "From ", window_start, " to ", window_end, ", ", what, " ", direction, " by ",
    num(abs(growth), 1), "% annually", versus_median, "."
  )
}
out["Median countries"] <- paste0("median (", length(INC_MEMBERS), " countries)")
out["Index base year"] <- paste0("Government health spending, ", window_start, " = 100")

# the last value of each panel's two lines
PANEL_NAME <- c(
  spend = "spending index",
  ncd = "premature NCD deaths",
  u5 = "under-five deaths",
  uhc = "service coverage"
)
for (k in names(PANEL_NAME)) {
  panel_rows <- filter(PANELS, panel == k)
  digits <- if (k == "ncd") 1 else 0
  own_values <- panel_rows$country[is.finite(panel_rows$country)]
  if (length(own_values) < 2) next
  median_values <- panel_rows$median[is.finite(panel_rows$median)]
  out[paste0("Last value, ", PANEL_NAME[[k]], ", ", SHORT)] <- num(tail(own_values, 1), digits)
  if (length(median_values) > 0) {
    out[paste0("Last value, ", PANEL_NAME[[k]], ", median")] <- num(tail(median_values, 1), digits)
  }
}
if (all(is.finite(spend_levels))) {
  # the levels are in local currency at 2023 prices (GHED's 2023 rate), else in US$
  if (LCU_MAIN) {
    from_text <- fmt_money(spend_levels[["from"]] * LCU$rate)
    to_text <- fmt_money(spend_levels[["to"]] * LCU$rate)
  } else {
    from_text <- fmt_money(spend_levels[["from"]], "US$")
    to_text <- fmt_money(spend_levels[["to"]], "US$")
  }
  out["Spending levels"] <- paste0("(", from_text, " to ", to_text, " per person)")
}

# the measures on which the country is better than the median in the latest year
shown <- filter(TR$rows, id %in% c("ncd", "u5", "uhc"), is.finite(gap_latest))
n_shown <- nrow(shown)
n_better <- sum(shown$gap_latest > 0)
if (n_shown > 0) {
  how_many <- case_when(
    n_better == n_shown ~ paste("all", n_shown),
    n_better == 0 ~ paste("none of the", n_shown),
    TRUE ~ paste(n_better, "of the", n_shown)
  )
  out["Measures above the median"] <- paste0(how_many, " outcome and coverage measures")
}

# the first and the latest survey of financial hardship inside the window
hardship_row <- filter(TR$rows, id %in% "hardship")
if (nrow(hardship_row) == 0) {
  out["Financial hardship"] <- paste0("since ", window_start, ", so its direction is not known")
} else if (hardship_row$verdict == "oneSurvey") {
  out["Financial hardship"] <- paste0(
    "One survey of financial hardship since ", window_start, " (",
    num(hardship_row$latest, 1, suffix = "%"), " in ", hardship_row$latest_year, ")"
  )
} else {
  out["Financial hardship"] <- paste0(
    "from ", num(hardship_row$start, 1, suffix = "%"), " in ", hardship_row$start_year,
    " to ", num(hardship_row$latest, 1, suffix = "%"), " in ", hardship_row$latest_year
  )
}
if (!is.null(FALLBACK_NOTE)) {
  out["Currency note"] <- FALLBACK_NOTE
}
slide_values[[7]] <- out
knitr::kable(tibble::enframe(slide_values[[7]], name = "What the slide prints", value = "Value"))

# Four panels: the country and the income-group median, year by year
titles <- c(
  spend = paste0("Government health spending, ", window_start, " = 100"),
  ncd = "Premature NCD deaths, ages 30 to 70, %",
  u5 = "Under-five deaths per 1,000 births",
  uhc = "Service coverage index (0 to 100)"
)
median_label <- paste(ADJ_CAP, "median")
panel_lines <- bind_rows(
  transmute(PANELS, panel, year, v = country, who = SHORT),
  transmute(PANELS, panel, year, v = median, who = median_label)
) |>
  filter(is.finite(v)) |>
  mutate(panel = factor(titles[panel], levels = titles))
line_ends <- panel_lines |>
  group_by(panel, who) |>
  slice_max(year, n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(lab = ifelse(grepl("NCD", panel), num(v, 1), num(v, 0)))
# the middle tick: the deck rounds a half year up
middle_year <- ceiling((window_start + window_end) / 2)
ggplot(panel_lines, aes(year, v, colour = who, linetype = who)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +

    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.12))
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(c(WB[["teal"]], WB[["muted"]]), c(SHORT, median_label))) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = setNames(c("solid", "dashed"), c(SHORT, median_label))) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(SHORT, " and the ", ADJ, " median, ", window_start, " to ", window_end),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_deck()
```

## Slide 8. Do health budgets translate into services?

We compare government health spending per person and five service coverage measures, each as a percentage of the `r ADJ` median. Spending is the latest year with a publishable median, in PPP international dollars; services use each country's latest value in 2014 to 2023 against the median of members' latest values. A row more than 10% below the median is a shortfall. Coverage is capped at 100%, so its ratios move less than spending; the slide does not show that spending produces coverage. Global data do not show whether the budget is released and spent as planned.

```{r slide-08-budgets-to-services}
SVC_LABEL <- c(
  spending = "Government health spending per person",
  uhc = "UHC service coverage index",
  measles = "Children vaccinated against measles",
  births = "Births attended by skilled staff",
  tb_success = "Tuberculosis treatment success",
  art = "People with HIV on treatment"
)

# We build slide 8 with spending in PPP, and the same slide in US$ for annex A5 (slide 20)
SLIDE8 <- list()
versions <- if (LCU_MAIN) c("main", "annex") else "main"
for (version in versions) {
  ppp <- version == "main" && LCU_MAIN
  if (!SVC$ready) {
    message_text <- paste(
      "Government health spending and service coverage are not published for this country up",
      "to the selected year."
    )
    SLIDE8[[version]] <- list(values = c("Message" = message_text))
    next
  }
  rows <- SVC[[if (ppp) "ppp" else "usd"]]

  # How each row prints: spending in money, the coverage index as a number, the other services
  # in %. A row's year is added when it differs from the spending year.
  spending_year <- rows$year[1]
  is_index <- rows$id == "uhc"
  rows$value_text <- ifelse(is_index, num(rows$value, 0), num(rows$value, 0, suffix = "%"))
  rows$median_text <- ifelse(is_index, num(rows$median, 0), num(rows$median, 0, suffix = "%"))
  rows$value_text[1] <- fmt_money(rows$value[1], if (ppp) "Int$" else "US$")
  rows$median_text[1] <- fmt_money(rows$median[1], if (ppp) "Int$" else "US$")
  rows$value_text[!is.finite(rows$value)] <- NA_TXT
  rows$median_text[!is.finite(rows$median)] <- NA_TXT
  shows_year <- is.finite(rows$year) & !(rows$year %in% spending_year)
  rows$year_text <- ifelse(shows_year, paste0(" (", rows$year, ")"), "")
  rows$of_median <- num(rows$ratio * 100, 0, suffix = "%")

  out <- c()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
    label <- SVC_LABEL[[rows$id[i]]]
    if (is.finite(rows$value[i])) {
      out[label] <- paste0(rows$value_text[i], rows$year_text[i])
    } else {
      out[label] <- NA_TXT
    }
    if (is.finite(rows$median[i])) {
      out[paste0(label, ", median")] <- rows$median_text[i]
    }
  }
  for (i in which(rows$id %in% c("spending", "uhc") & is.finite(rows$ratio))) {
    out[paste0(SVC_LABEL[[rows$id[i]]], ", % of the median")] <- rows$of_median[i]
  }

  # the lead: spending against its median, set beside the UHC index when both exist
  spending_row <- rows[1, ]
  uhc_row <- rows[rows$id == "uhc", ]
  in_ppp <- if (ppp) " in PPP terms" else ""
  if (is.finite(spending_row$ratio) && is.finite(uhc_row$ratio)) {
    link <- case_when(
      uhc_row$ratio < spending_row$ratio - 0.1 ~ "but",
      uhc_row$ratio > spending_row$ratio + 0.1 ~ "while",
      TRUE ~ "and"
    )
    out["Lead"] <- paste0(
      "In ", spending_year, ", government health spending per person was ",
      spending_row$of_median, " of the ", ADJ, " median", in_ppp, ", ", link,
      " the UHC service coverage index was ", uhc_row$of_median, " of it (",
      uhc_row$value_text, " against ", uhc_row$median_text, uhc_row$year_text, ")."
    )
  } else if (is.finite(spending_row$ratio)) {
    out["Lead"] <- paste0(
      "In ", spending_year, ", government health spending per person was ",
      spending_row$of_median, " of the ", ADJ, " median", in_ppp,
      " (", spending_row$value_text, " against ", spending_row$median_text, ")"
    )
  } else if (is.finite(uhc_row$ratio)) {
    uhc_year <- if (is.finite(uhc_row$year)) paste0(" (", uhc_row$year, ")") else ""
    out["Lead"] <- paste0(
      "The UHC service coverage index was ", uhc_row$of_median, " of the ", ADJ, " median",
      uhc_year
    )
  }
  out["Figure note"] <- paste0("median of ", SVC$N, " ", ADJ, " countries")
  out["Years"] <- paste0(
    "Spending: ", spending_year, if (ppp) ", PPP international dollars" else "",
    "; services: latest value ", SVC$window[1], " to ", SVC$window[2]
  )

  # the service furthest below its median, or how many services are below it
  services_shown <- rows[rows$id != "spending" & is.finite(rows$ratio), ]
  other_services <- services_shown[services_shown$id != "uhc", ]
  weakest <- other_services[which.min(other_services$ratio), ]
  if (nrow(weakest) > 0 && weakest$ratio < 0.9) {
    out["Furthest below the median"] <- paste0(
      "furthest below the median: ", weakest$value_text, " against ", weakest$median_text,
      weakest$year_text
    )
  } else if (nrow(services_shown) > 1) {
    n_short <- sum(services_shown$shortfall)
    out["Services below the median"] <- if (n_short > 0) {
      paste0(n_short, " of ", nrow(services_shown), " service measures")
    } else {
      paste0("None of the ", nrow(services_shown), " service measures")
    }
  }

  # The figure: each row as a percentage of its median, on a log scale
  dots <- data.frame(row = SVC_LABEL[rows$id], pc = 100 * rows$ratio, short = rows$shortfall)
  dots$row[1] <- paste0(dots$row[1], if (ppp) ", PPP" else "")
  dots$row <- factor(dots$row, levels = rev(dots$row))
  dots <- dots[is.finite(dots$pc), ]
  x_limits <- range(c(50, 200, dots$pc / 1.25, dots$pc * 1.25))
  p <- ggplot(dots, aes(pc, row, colour = short)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", colour = WB[["muted"]]) +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    geom_text(aes(label = num(pc, 0, suffix = "%")), vjust = -1, size = 3.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(`FALSE` = WB[["teal"]], `TRUE` = WB[["rust"]]),
      labels = c(
        `FALSE` = "Within 10% of the median or above",
        `TRUE` = "More than 10% below the median"
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = c(5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 200, 400, 1000), limits = x_limits) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("% of the ", ADJ, " median"),
      x = paste0("% of the ", ADJ, " median, log scale"),
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_deck()
  SLIDE8[[version]] <- list(values = out, plot = p)
}

values <- SLIDE8$main$values
if (SVC$ready && !is.null(FALLBACK_NOTE)) {
  values["Currency note"] <- FALLBACK_NOTE
}
slide_values[[8]] <- values
knitr::kable(tibble::enframe(slide_values[[8]], name = "What the slide prints", value = "Value"))
if (!is.null(SLIDE8$main$plot)) print(SLIDE8$main$plot)
```

## Slide 9. Does the country have the health workforce it needs?

We compare doctors plus nurses and midwives per 1,000 people, in years when both are reported, with the `r ADJ` median (each member's latest value in the five years to the year shown) and the WHO threshold of 4.45 per 1,000, the density associated with reaching the median of twelve SDG tracer indicators. The threshold is a planning benchmark, not a staffing norm. A jump between years often reflects what was counted (the private sector, or licensed rather than active workers), not a workforce change.

```{r slide-09-workforce}
out <- c()
if (!WF$ready) {
  # Doctors and nurses are never reported for the same year: we say so, with each figure on
  # its own (two decimals below 10, one above)
  published <- c()
  if (nrow(phys_last) > 0) {
    phys_digits <- if (phys_last$value < 10) 2 else 1
    published <- c(published, paste0(
      "doctors ", num(phys_last$value, phys_digits), " per 1,000 (", phys_last$year, ")"
    ))
  }
  if (nrow(nurse_last) > 0) {
    nurse_digits <- if (nurse_last$value < 10) 2 else 1
    published <- c(published, paste0(
      "nurses and midwives ", num(nurse_last$value, nurse_digits), " per 1,000 (",
      nurse_last$year, ")"
    ))
  }
  out["Message"] <- paste0(
    "Doctors and nurses are not reported for the same year for ", SHORT, " up to ", MAX_YEAR,
    ", so the combined density cannot be compared."
  )
  if (length(published) > 0) {
    out["Published separately"] <- paste0(
      "Published separately: ", knitr::combine_words(published, oxford_comma = FALSE), "."
    )
  }
} else {
  latest <- WF$latest
  earlier <- WF$earlier
  # densities print to two decimals below 10 and to one above
  densities <- c(
    value = latest$value,
    median = latest$median,
    phys = latest$phys,
    nurse = latest$nurse,
    earlier = if (is.null(earlier)) NA else earlier$value,
    earlier_median = if (is.null(earlier)) NA else earlier$median
  )
  density_text <- ifelse(densities < 10, num(densities, 2), num(densities, 1))
  if (!is.finite(latest$median)) {
    versus_median <- paste0("the ", ADJ, " median is not published for that year")
  } else {
    position <- case_when(
      latest$value >= latest$median * 1.05 ~ "above",
      latest$value <= latest$median * 0.95 ~ "below",
      TRUE ~ "close to"
    )
    versus_median <- paste0(position, " the ", ADJ, " median of ", density_text[["median"]])
  }
  versus_threshold <- case_when(
    latest$value >= WF_THRESHOLD ~ "above",
    latest$value >= WF_THRESHOLD * 0.8 ~ "just below",
    TRUE ~ "below"
  )
  out["Lead"] <- paste0(
    "In ", latest$year, ", ", SHORT, " had ", density_text[["value"]],
    " doctors, nurses and midwives per 1,000 people, ", versus_median, ", and ",
    versus_threshold, " the WHO threshold of 4.45."
  )
  out["Latest value on the chart"] <- density_text[["value"]]
  out["Threshold on the chart"] <- "4.45"
  out["Figure note"] <- paste0("median of ", WF$N, " ", ADJ, " countries")
  if (is.finite(latest$phys) && is.finite(latest$nurse)) {
    out["Doctors, nurses and midwives"] <- paste0(
      "Doctors ", density_text[["phys"]], ", nurses and midwives ", density_text[["nurse"]],
      " per 1,000 (",
      latest$year, ")."
    )
  }
  if (!is.null(earlier)) {
    direction <- case_when(
      latest$value > earlier$value * 1.05 ~ "Up from",
      latest$value < earlier$value * 0.95 ~ "Down from",
      TRUE ~ "About the same as"
    )
    median_moved <- ""
    if (is.finite(earlier$median) && is.finite(latest$median)) {
      median_moved <- paste0(
        "; the median moved from ", density_text[["earlier_median"]], " to ",
        density_text[["median"]]
      )
    }
    out["Earlier value"] <- paste0(
      direction, " ", density_text[["earlier"]], " in ", earlier$year, median_moved, "."
    )
  }
}
slide_values[[9]] <- out
knitr::kable(tibble::enframe(slide_values[[9]], name = "What the slide prints", value = "Value"))

# The figure: the country's density, the income-group median and the WHO threshold
if (WF$ready) {
  country_points <- WF$pts
  # we do not draw a line across a gap of more than three years
  country_points$run <- cumsum(c(1, diff(country_points$year) > 3))
  ggplot() +
    geom_line(
      data = filter(WF$medians, is.finite(value)),
      aes(year, value, colour = "median"),
      linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = WF_THRESHOLD, colour = "threshold"), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_line(
      data = country_points,
      aes(year, both, group = run, colour = "country"),
      linewidth = 1.3
    ) +
    geom_point(data = country_points, aes(year, both, colour = "country"), size = 2.6) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(country = WB[["teal"]], median = WB[["muted"]], threshold = WB[["gold"]]),
      labels = c(
        country = SHORT,
        median = paste(ADJ_CAP, "median"),
        threshold = "WHO threshold, 4.45"
      )
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
    labs(
      title = "Doctors, nurses and midwives per 1,000 people",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Per 1,000 people"
    ) +
    theme_deck()
}
```

## Slide 10. Are essential medicines available, and who pays for them?

We show medicines and other medical goods bought outside a visit or a stay (WHO health accounts line HC.5.1) as a share of `r poss(SHORT)` current health spending, by year, and who paid where the accounts report it. Medicines given during a visit or a hospital stay are counted with that care, so a country whose facilities dispense most medicines shows a small share; this is not all spending on medicines. Private sources are households, insurers, non-profits and firms together, because global data do not separate out-of-pocket payments for medicines. Availability in facilities (SDG 3.b.3) is published for few countries.

```{r slide-10-medicines}
PAYER <- c(pvt = "private sources", gov = "the government", ext = "external sources")
# shares print to one decimal below 10% and to the unit above
med_bars <- MED$bars |>
  mutate(share_text = ifelse(share < 10, num(share, 1), num(share, 0)))
median_digits <- if (isTRUE(MED$median < 10)) 1 else 0
median_text <- num(MED$median, median_digits, suffix = "%")
if (!is.null(MED$avail)) {
  avail <- paste0(
    "available and affordable in ", num(MED$avail$value, 0), "% of facilities (",
    MED$avail$year, ")."
  )
} else {
  avail <- paste0(
    "Whether essential medicines are in stock in ", poss(SHORT),
    " health facilities is not in global data."
  )
}

out <- c()
if (!MED$ready) {
  out["Message"] <- paste0(
    "WHO health accounts do not publish spending on medicines for ", SHORT, " up to ",
    MAX_YEAR, ", nor who pays for them."
  )
  out["Availability"] <- avail
} else {
  last <- MED$last
  opening <- paste0(
    "In ", last$year, ", medicines bought from pharmacies and shops took ",
    med_bars$share_text[nrow(med_bars)], "% of current health spending",
    if (is.finite(MED$median)) paste0(" (", ADJ, " median ", median_text, ")") else ""
  )
  # who paid the most: in the latest year, or in the latest year with a split
  split_row <- if (is.finite(last$pvt)) last else MED$last_split
  payers <- c()
  if (!is.null(split_row)) {
    payers <- c(pvt = split_row$pvt, gov = split_row$gov, ext = split_row$ext)
  }
  payers <- payers[is.finite(payers)]
  top_payer <- names(payers)[which.max(payers)]
  if (is.finite(last$pvt)) {
    out["Lead"] <- paste0(
      opening, "; ", PAYER[[top_payer]], " paid ", num(max(payers), 0), "% of it."
    )
  } else if (length(payers) > 0) {
    out["Lead"] <- paste0(
      opening, "; in ", split_row$year, ", the latest year with a split, ",
      PAYER[[top_payer]], " paid ", num(max(payers), 0), "% of it."
    )
  } else {
    out["Lead"] <- paste0(opening, "; WHO health accounts do not show who paid.")
  }
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(med_bars))) {
    out[paste("Bar", med_bars$year[i])] <- paste0(med_bars$share_text[i], "%")
  }
  if (is.finite(MED$median)) {
    out["Median line"] <- paste(ADJ_CAP, "median", median_text)
    out["Median note"] <- paste0(
      "median of ", MED$n, " reporting ", ADJ, " countries, latest value ", MED$window[1],
      " to ", MED$window[2]
    )
  }
  out["Availability"] <- avail
}
slide_values[[10]] <- out
knitr::kable(tibble::enframe(slide_values[[10]], name = "What the slide prints", value = "Value"))

if (MED$ready) {
  # each year's bar split by who paid, where the accounts say
  by_payer <- med_bars |>
    filter(is.finite(pvt)) |>
    transmute(
      year,
      `Private sources` = share * pvt / 100,
      Government = share * gov / 100,
      `External sources` = share * ext / 100
    ) |>
    pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "payer", values_to = "v")
  not_split <- med_bars |>
    filter(!is.finite(pvt)) |>
    transmute(year, payer = "Payer not reported", v = share)
  payer_order <- c("External sources", "Government", "Private sources", "Payer not reported")
  stacks <- bind_rows(by_payer, not_split) |>
    mutate(payer = factor(payer, levels = payer_order))
  p <- ggplot(stacks, aes(factor(year), v, fill = payer)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.62) +
    geom_text(
      data = med_bars,
      aes(factor(year), share, label = paste0(share_text, "%")),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.5, fontface = "bold", size = 3.6
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Private sources" = WB[["dark"]],
        Government = WB[["teal"]],
        "External sources" = WB[["grey"]],
        "Payer not reported" = WB[["tint"]]
      ),
      drop = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
    labs(
      title = "Medicines bought outside a visit or a stay, % of current health spending",
      x = NULL,
      y = "% of current health spending"
    ) +
    theme_deck()
  if (is.finite(MED$median)) {
    p <- p + geom_hline(yintercept = MED$median, linetype = "dashed", colour = WB[["muted"]])
  }
  p
}
```

## Slide 11. Does funding reach the services and populations with the greatest need?

`r if (isTRUE(PREV$ready)) paste0("The lines show the share of ", if (PREV$tier == "all") "current health spending from all sources" else "government health spending", " that went to preventive and to curative care each year, from ", c(gov = "WHO health accounts, financed by government", cofog = "IMF government spending by function", all = "WHO health accounts, all sources")[[PREV$tier]], ".") else "WHO health accounts and IMF statistics publish no split of government health spending by function for this country, so the slide shows need against the income-group median instead."` The concern behind the slide is that public health spending tends to stay flat or fall while curative care takes a growing share. The sentence beside the chart names the measure of need furthest above the `r ADJ` median among eleven burden and coverage measures. The years 2020 to 2022 include COVID-19 testing and vaccination, counted as preventive care; identical consecutive-year shares usually mean one year's split was applied to others. Global data do not show how spending is shared across regions and population groups.

```{r slide-11-funding-and-need}
NEED_LABEL <- c(
  u5 = "Under-five deaths per 1,000 births",
  maternal = "Maternal deaths per 100,000 births",
  stunting = "Child stunting, %",
  tb = "Tuberculosis cases per 100,000",
  hiv = "New HIV infections per 1,000 adults",
  malaria = "Malaria cases per 1,000 at risk",
  ncd = "Early death from chronic disease, %",
  dtp = "Children without DTP3, %",
  births = "Births without a skilled attendant, %",
  art = "People with HIV not on treatment, %",
  tb_success = "TB cases not treated successfully, %"
)

# the measure of need furthest above its median
top_need <- if (nrow(NEED) > 0) NEED[which.max(NEED$ratio), ] else NULL
need_sentence <- NULL
if (!is.null(top_need) && top_need$ratio > 1.1) {
  need_sentence <- paste0(
    "Need is highest for ", top_need$short, ": ", num(top_need$ratio, 1), " times the ", ADJ,
    " median (", top_need$year, ")."
  )
} else if (nrow(NEED) > 0) {
  need_sentence <- paste0(
    "None of the ", nrow(NEED), " need measures is more than 10% above the ", ADJ, " median."
  )
}

out <- c()
if (!PREV$ready && nrow(NEED) == 0) {
  out["Message"] <- paste0(
    "How ", poss(SHORT), " government health spending divides between prevention and",
    " treatment is not published up to ", MAX_YEAR, "."
  )
} else if (!PREV$ready) {
  # No split of spending by function: the slide shows need against the median instead, up to
  # eight measures
  if (top_need$ratio > 1.1) {
    out["Lead"] <- need_sentence
  } else {
    out["Lead"] <- paste0("No need measure is more than 10% above the ", ADJ, " median.")
  }
  # a year is printed only where it differs from the most common year (the latest of ties)
  year_counts <- table(NEED$year)
  common_year <- max(as.integer(names(year_counts)[year_counts == max(year_counts)]))
  shown <- head(arrange(NEED, desc(ratio)), 8)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(shown))) {
    need <- shown[i, ]
    value_digits <- if (abs(need$value) < 10) 1 else 0
    median_digits <- if (abs(need$median) < 10) 1 else 0
    year_note <- if (need$year != common_year) paste0(" (", need$year, ")") else ""
    out[NEED_LABEL[[need$id]]] <- paste0(num(need$value, value_digits), year_note)
    out[paste0(NEED_LABEL[[need$id]], ", median")] <- num(need$median, median_digits)
  }
} else {
  prev_points <- PREV$pts
  last <- prev_points[nrow(prev_points), ]
  tier_words <- list(
    gov = c("Preventive care", "Curative care", "government health spending"),
    cofog = c(
      "Public health services",
      "Hospital and outpatient services",
      "government health spending (IMF, general government)"
    ),
    all = c("Preventive care", "Curative care", "current health spending from all sources")
  )[[PREV$tier]]
  # the earlier point of comparison: the first year at least three years before the latest,
  # else the first year
  if (any(prev_points$year <= last$year - 3)) {
    earlier <- prev_points[which(prev_points$year <= last$year - 3)[1], ]
  } else if (nrow(prev_points) > 1) {
    earlier <- prev_points[1, ]
  } else {
    earlier <- NULL
  }
  curative_part <- ""
  if (is.finite(last$cur)) {
    curative_part <- paste0("; ", tolower(tier_words[2]), " took ", num(last$cur, 1), "%")
  }
  change <- ""
  if (!is.null(earlier) && abs(last$prev - earlier$prev) < 0.5) {
    change <- paste0(", about the same as the ", num(earlier$prev, 1), "% of ", earlier$year)
  } else if (!is.null(earlier)) {
    direction <- if (last$prev > earlier$prev) "up" else "down"
    change <- paste0(", ", direction, " from ", num(earlier$prev, 1), "% in ", earlier$year)
  }
  out["Lead"] <- paste0(
    "In ", last$year, ", ", tolower(tier_words[1]), " took ", num(last$prev, 1), "% of ",
    tier_words[3], change, curative_part, "."
  )
  with_curative <- prev_points[is.finite(prev_points$cur), ]
  if (nrow(with_curative) > 0) {
    last_curative <- with_curative$cur[nrow(with_curative)]
    out["Curative care, last value"] <- num(last_curative, 1, suffix = "%")
  }
  out["Preventive care, last value"] <- num(last$prev, 1, suffix = "%")
  if (isTRUE(is.finite(PREV$median$value))) {
    out["Median label"] <- paste(ADJ_CAP, "median", num(PREV$median$value, 1, suffix = "%"))
    out["Median window"] <- paste0(
      "latest preventive share, ", PREV$window[1], " to ", PREV$window[2]
    )
  }
  if (!is.null(PREV$flat)) {
    out["Identical years"] <- paste0(
      "The split is the same in ", PREV$flat[1], " to ", PREV$flat[2]
    )
  }
  if (length(PREV$swings) > 0) {
    swing_years <- knitr::combine_words(as.character(PREV$swings), oxford_comma = FALSE)
    out["Large one-year moves"] <- paste0("(", swing_years, ")")
  }
  if (!is.null(need_sentence)) {
    out["Need"] <- need_sentence
  }
}
slide_values[[11]] <- out
knitr::kable(tibble::enframe(slide_values[[11]], name = "What the slide prints", value = "Value"))

if (PREV$ready) {
  # the two shares year by year, with the income-group median of the preventive share
  shares <- bind_rows(
    transmute(PREV$pts, year, v = prev, what = "Preventive"),
    transmute(PREV$pts, year, v = cur, what = "Curative")
  ) |>
    filter(is.finite(v))
  last_points <- shares |>

    slice_max(year, n = 1)
  p <- ggplot(shares, aes(year, v, colour = what)) +

    geom_text(

    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(PREV$pts$year)) +

  if (isTRUE(is.finite(PREV$median$value))) {

    p <- p +

} else if (nrow(NEED) > 0) {

  p <- ggplot(need_dots, aes(ratio, row)) +

    labs(
      title = paste0("Need against the ", ADJ, " median"),

    ) +
```
