## Slide 12. Do pooling and purchasing arrangements support the right care?

We split `r poss(SHORT)` current health spending by financing scheme in `r if (isTRUE(POOL$ready)) POOL$year else "the latest year"`: compulsory schemes (of which government schemes and compulsory insurance), voluntary schemes and out-of-pocket payments, compared with the `r ADJ` median and the group's middle half. The sentence beside the chart reads the country's provider payment record for the main way primary, outpatient and hospital care are paid. A large compulsory share means money is pooled before people fall ill; external money is a source spent through these schemes, so it is not a row of its own. What a payment method can encourage is an expected signal from WHO's guide on mixed provider payment, not observed behaviour.

```{r slide-12-pooling-purchasing}
# The provider payment sentence: the main methods by level of care, as recorded
if (!PAY$present) {
  payment <- "How providers are paid is not documented in the sources reviewed."
} else if (PAY$cap_case) {
  payment <- paste(
    "Primary care is paid a fixed amount per person and hospitals per case, which can reward",
    "extra hospital cases unless volume or spending is capped."
  )
} else {
  # a method name that starts like a word ("Capitation") is lower-cased in the sentence
  main_methods <- PAY$groups |>
    filter(main, care %in% c("primary", "ambulatory", "hospital")) |>
    arrange(rank) |>
    mutate(
      starts_like_word = grepl("^[A-Z][a-z]", method),
      method = ifelse(
        starts_like_word,
        paste0(tolower(substr(method, 1, 1)), substring(method, 2)),
        method
      )
    ) |>
    distinct(title, method)
  if (nrow(main_methods) > 0) {
    # up to three levels of care, each with up to two methods: "primary care is mainly paid
    # by capitation and ..."
    levels_of_care <- head(unique(main_methods$title), 3)
    parts <- c()
    for (i in seq_along(levels_of_care)) {
      methods <- head(main_methods$method[main_methods$title == levels_of_care[i]], 2)
      methods <- methods[nzchar(methods)] # an empty method name is left out
      verb <- if (i == 1) " is mainly paid" else ""
      parts[i] <- paste0(
        tolower(levels_of_care[i]), verb, " by ",
        knitr::combine_words(methods, oxford_comma = FALSE)
      )
    }
    payment <- paste0("As recorded, ", knitr::combine_words(parts, oxford_comma = FALSE), ".")
  } else if (PAY$fragmentation) {
    payment <- "The payment record documents fragmented pooling or purchasing."
  } else {
    payment <- paste(
      "How providers are paid is documented in text only, so incentives cannot be read",
      "method by method."
    )
  }
}

POOL_LABEL <- c(
  cfa = "Compulsory schemes, total",
  gov = "of which government schemes",
  chi = "of which compulsory insurance",
  vol = "Voluntary schemes",
  oop = "Out-of-pocket payments",
  rest = "Rest of world or unclassified"
)
out <- c()
if (!POOL$ready) {
  out["Message"] <- paste(
    "WHO health accounts do not publish how current health spending divides between",
    "compulsory schemes, voluntary schemes and out-of-pocket payments for this country up to",
    "the selected year."
  )
  out["Provider payment"] <- payment
} else {
  schemes_shown <- POOL$rows
  schemes_shown$value_text <- num(schemes_shown$value, 0, suffix = "%")
  schemes_shown$median_text <- paste0(num(schemes_shown$median, 0), "%")
  cfa <- schemes_shown[schemes_shown$id == "cfa", ]
  oop <- schemes_shown[schemes_shown$id == "oop", ]
  vol <- schemes_shown[schemes_shown$id == "vol", ]
  if (is.finite(cfa$median)) {
    cfa_versus <- paste0(", against ", AN_ADJ, " ", ADJ, " median of ", cfa$median_text)
  } else {
    cfa_versus <- paste0(" (no publishable ", ADJ, " median)")
  }
  oop_part <- "."
  if (is.finite(oop$value)) {
    oop_median <- if (is.finite(oop$median)) paste0(" (median ", oop$median_text, ")") else ""
    oop_part <- paste0("; households paid ", oop$value_text, " out of pocket", oop_median, ".")
  }
  out["Lead"] <- paste0(
    "In ", POOL$year, ", ", cfa$value_text,
    " of current health spending was pooled through compulsory schemes", cfa_versus, oop_part
  )
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(schemes_shown))) {
    label <- POOL_LABEL[[schemes_shown$id[i]]]
    out[paste("Row:", label)] <- schemes_shown$value_text[i]
    if (is.finite(schemes_shown$median[i])) {
      out[paste("Median:", label)] <- schemes_shown$median_text[i]
    }
  }
  out["Year of the comparison"] <- paste0("(25th to 75th percentile), ", POOL$year)
  out["Provider payment"] <- payment
  # a large voluntary share, else a large external share
  if (isTRUE(vol$value >= 25 & vol$value - vol$median >= 10)) {
    out["Voluntary schemes"] <- paste0(
      "Voluntary schemes carry ", vol$value_text, ", against a median of ", vol$median_text
    )
  } else if (isTRUE(POOL$ext$value >= 20)) {
    ext_median <- ""
    if (is.finite(POOL$ext$median)) {
      ext_median <- paste0(" (", ADJ, " median ", num(POOL$ext$median, 0, suffix = "%"), ")")
    }
    out["External sources"] <- paste0(
      "External sources fund ", num(POOL$ext$value, 0, suffix = "%"),
      " of current health spending", ext_median
    )
  }
  if (PAY$present && !is.null(PAY$supplement)) {
    n_public <- PAY$supplement$n_sources
    out["Payment source"] <- paste0(
      "from ", n_public, " public ", if (n_public == 1) "source" else "sources", "."
    )
  } else if (PAY$present) {
    out["Payment source"] <- paste0(
      "Health Payment Explorer country record (", PAY$n_sources, " cited sources)."
    )
  }
}
slide_values[[12]] <- out
knitr::kable(tibble::enframe(slide_values[[12]], name = "What the slide prints", value = "Value"))

if (POOL$ready) {
  # each scheme: the country (dot), the median (tick) and the middle half of the group (grey bar)
  schemes_shown$row <- factor(
    POOL_LABEL[schemes_shown$id],
    levels = rev(POOL_LABEL[schemes_shown$id])
```

## Slide 13. What is health budget space?

The slide defines health budget space as the additional government health expenditure that can plausibly be accommodated over the next one or two budget cycles, given the expected macro-fiscal envelope and a feasible change in health's share of government spending; it is not a target. The slide also defines the two horizons and the two scenarios used on slides 14 and 15. We take the only numbers on this slide, the horizon years, from the projection so the definition and projection cannot disagree: the first two years after the IMF vintage of 2026, and the projection's last year.

```{r slide-13-budget-space}
# The horizons come from the projection, so that the definition and the projection cannot
# disagree: the first projection year after the IMF vintage and the year after it, and the
# last projection year
years_ahead <- if (PROJ$ready) PROJ$rows$year else integer()
near <- if (any(years_ahead > VINTAGE)) years_ahead[years_ahead > VINTAGE][1] else VINTAGE + 1
last_year <- if (length(years_ahead) > 0) max(years_ahead) else VINTAGE + 5
slide_values[[13]] <- c(
  "Near-term horizon" = paste0("(", near, " to ", near + 1, ")"),
  "Medium-term horizon" = paste0("through ", last_year)
)
knitr::kable(tibble::enframe(slide_values[[13]], name = "What the slide prints", value = "Value"))
```

## Slide 14. What fiscal space can growth and health prioritisation create?

We show how much government health spending per person would change from `r if (PROJ$ready) PROJ$base$year else "the base year"` in each projection year, in `r CUR_NAME` at 2023 prices, and where the change came from: economic growth, the size of the government budget, and, in the illustrative scenario, a health share rising one point a year from 2027. The number after each bar is the level reached. To read it, the passive scenario shows what the IMF's paths give with health's share held; the rise of one point a year is a default for discussion, not a finding about what is feasible. The base-year comparators understate the distance in later years because peers grow too. We print a label inside a bar only where the deck's bar is wide enough to hold it, as calculated in the chunk from the deck's chart geometry.

```{r slide-14-fiscal-space}
# We build slide 14 in local currency at 2023 prices, and the same slide in US$ for annex A6
# (slide 21)
PART_NAME <- c(growth = "economic growth", budget = "government budget", prio = "reprioritisation")
SLIDE14 <- list()
versions <- if (LCU_MAIN) c("main", "annex") else "main"
for (version in versions) {
  lcu <- version == "main" && LCU_MAIN
  currency <- if (lcu) "local" else "US$"
  if (!PROJ$ready) {
    message_text <- paste(
      "Government health spending per person and its parts are not published for one common",
      "year, so the fiscal space cannot be estimated."
    )
    SLIDE14[[version]] <- list(values = c("Message" = message_text))
    next
  }
  base_year <- PROJ$base$year
  proj_rows <- PROJ$rows
  base <- PROJ$base$ghe_pc
  if (lcu) {
    # every amount in local currency at 2023 prices
    rate <- to_lcu$factor[match(base_year, to_lcu$year)]
    base <- base * rate
    for (k in c("trend", "priority", "growth", "budget", "prio")) {
      proj_rows[[k]] <- proj_rows[[k]] * rate
    }
  }
  last_row <- proj_rows[nrow(proj_rows), ] # the last horizon
  first_row <- proj_rows[proj_rows$h == 1, ] # one year after the start
  no_change <- all(abs(proj_rows$priority - base) < 1e-9)
  growth_source <- PROJ$growth$source

  # the chart's unit: US$, or local currency in trillions, billions or millions (thousands
  # for six-figure changes)
  biggest <- max(0, abs(c(proj_rows$growth, proj_rows$budget, proj_rows$prio)), na.rm = TRUE)
  divisor <- case_when(
    !lcu ~ 1,
    biggest >= 1e12 ~ 1e12,
    biggest >= 1e9 ~ 1e9,
    biggest >= 1e6 ~ 1e6,
    biggest >= 1e5 ~ 1e3,
    TRUE ~ 1
  )
  unit_word <- case_when(
    divisor == 1e12 ~ " trillion",
    divisor == 1e9 ~ " billion",
    divisor == 1e6 ~ " million",
    divisor == 1e3 ~ " thousand",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
  axis_unit <- if (lcu) paste0(CODE, unit_word) else "US$"
  axis_title <- paste0(
    "Change from ", base_year, ", ", axis_unit, " per person at ", base_year, " prices"
  )
  # the level reached is printed after each bar; in local currency the deck widens the space
  # at the bar ends to fit the longest of these labels
  level_labels <- sapply(proj_rows$priority, fmt_money, currency = currency)
  end_width <- 128
  if (lcu) {
    end_width <- max(128, ceiling(max(nchar(level_labels)) * 22 * 0.62 + 12))
  }
  # each row: the year and how far it is from the start, or "estimate" for the start year
  is_estimate <- proj_rows$year == PROJ$start & PROJ$start != base_year &
    !(proj_rows$h %in% HORIZONS)
  years_after <- paste0("in ", proj_rows$h, " year", ifelse(proj_rows$h == 1, "", "s"))
  row_labels <- paste(proj_rows$year, ifelse(is_estimate, "estimate", years_after))

  out <- c()
  base_text <- fmt_money(base, currency)
  if (no_change) {
    out["Lead"] <- paste0(
      "Government health spending was ", base_text, " per person in ", base_year,
      "; with no growth series, no IMF projection and a health share already in the top",
      " quarter of all countries, no change is projected."
    )
  } else {
    amounts <- c(
      r_trend = fmt_money(last_row$trend, currency),
      n_trend = fmt_money(first_row$trend, currency),
      r_prio = fmt_money(last_row$priority, currency),
      n_prio = fmt_money(first_row$priority, currency)
    )
    # The candidate wordings of the lead, longest first: with and without the reason for past
    # growth in brackets, and in local currency with and without the currency code on the
    # projected amounts. We take the first that fits two lines.
    candidates <- c()
    for (with_reason in c(TRUE, FALSE)) {
      forms <- if (lcu) c("full", "bare") else "full"
      for (form in forms) {
        amount <- amounts
        if (form == "bare") {
          amount <- sub(paste0(CODE, NB), "", amounts, fixed = TRUE)
        }
        if (growth_source == "weo" && PROJ$budget == "weo") {
          opener <- "On the IMF outlook for growth and the budget,"
        } else if (growth_source == "weo") {
          opener <- "On the IMF growth outlook, with the budget held at its share of GDP,"
        } else if (growth_source == "past") {
          reason <- if (base_year < 2019) "early base year" else "no IMF projection"
          reason_text <- if (with_reason) paste0(" (", reason, ")") else ""
          opener <- paste0(
            "With past growth of ", num(PROJ$growth$rate, 1), "% a year assumed", reason_text, ","
          )
        } else {
          opener <- "With no growth series,"
        }
        moves <- paste0(
          opener, " government health spending moves from <b>", base_text, "</b> per person (",
          base_year, ") to <b>", amount[["r_trend"]], "</b> by ", last_row$year
        )
        two_horizons <- growth_source == "weo" && nrow(first_row) > 0 &&
          first_row$year != last_row$year
        if (PROJ$share$capped) {
          candidate <- paste0(
            moves, "; the health share, already in the top quarter of all countries, is held."
          )
        } else if (two_horizons) {
          candidate <- paste0(
            "Passive scenario (health's share unchanged): <b>", base_text, "</b> per person in ",
            base_year, ", <b>", amount[["n_trend"]], "</b> in ", first_row$year, " and <b>",
            amount[["r_trend"]], "</b> in ", last_row$year,
            ". An illustrative rise of one point a year from ", PROJ$start + 1,
            " takes it to <b>", amount[["n_prio"]], "</b> and <b>", amount[["r_prio"]], "</b>."
          )
        } else {
          candidate <- paste0(
            moves, "; a health share up one point a year from ", PROJ$start + 1,
            " takes it to <b>", amount[["r_prio"]], "</b>."
          )
        }
        candidates <- c(candidates, candidate)
      }
    }
    fits <- sapply(candidates, lead_width) <= LEAD_LIMIT
    chosen <- if (any(fits)) candidates[which(fits)[1]] else candidates[length(candidates)]
    out["Lead"] <- gsub("<[^>]+>", "", chosen) # the bold marks only served the width estimate

    # The bar labels. The deck's chart is 1,000 px wide with 168 px of row labels; a part of a
    # bar is labelled only when it is wide enough to hold its label.
    parts <- as.matrix(proj_rows[c("growth", "budget", "prio")])
    max_pos <- max(0.0001, rowSums(pmax(parts, 0)))
    min_neg <- min(0, rowSums(pmin(parts, 0)))
    plot_width <- 1000 - 168 - 24
    span <- (max_pos - min_neg) / max(0.3, (plot_width - end_width) / plot_width)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(proj_rows))) {
      for (k in c("growth", "budget", "prio")) {
        change <- proj_rows[[k]][i]
        if (!is.finite(change) || abs(change) < 1e-9) next
        size <- abs(change)
        if (divisor > 1) {
          in_unit <- size / divisor
          amount_text <- num(in_unit, case_when(in_unit >= 10 ~ 0, in_unit >= 1 ~ 1, TRUE ~ 2))
        } else if (lcu) {
          amount_text <- sub(paste0(CODE, NB), "", fmt_money(size), fixed = TRUE)
        } else {
          amount_text <- num(size, if (size < 10) 1 else 0)
        }
        label <- paste0(if (change < 0) "-" else "+", amount_text)
        bar_px <- size / span * plot_width
        if (bar_px >= nchar(label) * 22 * 0.6 + 14) {
          out[paste0("Bar label, ", proj_rows$year[i], ", ", PART_NAME[[k]])] <- label
        }
      }
      out[paste0("Level reached, ", proj_rows$year[i])] <- level_labels[i]
      out[paste0("Row label, ", proj_rows$year[i])] <- row_labels[i]
    }
    out["Axis"] <- axis_title
  }

  # the notes under the chart
  if (lcu) {
    imf_applied <- if (growth_source == "weo") {
      paste0(": the IMF's real growth applied to ", base_year, " values.")
    } else {
      "."
    }
    out["Note: prices"] <- paste0(
      "Constant ", BASE, " ", CUR_NAME, " (", RATE_TEXT, " in ", BASE, ", WHO GHED)", imf_applied
    )
  } else {
    out["Note: prices"] <- paste0("US$ at ", base_year, " prices and exchange rates.")
  }
  if (growth_source == "weo" || PROJ$budget == "weo") {
    series <- c(
      if (growth_source == "weo") "real GDP per person",
      if (PROJ$budget == "weo") "general government spending, % of GDP"
    )
    actual_to <- ""
    if (is.finite(PROJ$imf_actual)) {
      actual_to <- paste0(", actual to ", PROJ$imf_actual, ", projected after")
    }
    out["Note: IMF"] <- paste0(
      "IMF World Economic Outlook, October 2026: ", paste(series, collapse = " and "),
      actual_to, "."
    )
  }
  if (growth_source == "past") {
    out["Note: past growth"] <- paste0(
      ": past growth of ", num(PROJ$growth$rate, 1), "% a year (", PROJ$growth$y0, " to ",
      PROJ$growth$y1, ") assumed."
    )
  }
  if (PROJ$budget == "held") {
    out["Note: budget held"] <- paste0("spending held at its ", base_year, " share of GDP.")
  }
  if (PROJ$start > base_year) {
    then_rising <- ""
    if (!PROJ$share$capped) {
      at_most <- ""
      if (is.finite(PROJ$share$ceiling)) {
        at_most <- paste0(
          " to at most ", num(PROJ$share$ceiling, 1, suffix = "%"),
          ", the share a quarter of countries exceed"
        )
      }
      then_rising <- paste0(
        ", then up 1 point a year", at_most,
        ": illustrative, not yet empirically validated, not a forecast"
      )
    }
    out["Note: health share"] <- paste0(
      "Health share held at its ", base_year, " value to ", PROJ$start, then_rising, "."
    )
  }
  if (!no_change && nrow(first_row) > 0) {
    reprioritised <- if (PROJ$share$capped) {
      "the health share is already high."
    } else {
      first_prio <- fmt_money(first_row$priority, currency)
      paste0("with the illustrative reprioritisation, ", first_prio, ".")
    }
    out["Near term"] <- paste0(
      "(next one to two budget cycles, ", first_row$year, "): Passive scenario ",
      fmt_money(first_row$trend, currency), " per person; ", reprioritised
    )
  }
  adds_budget <- if (last_row$budget >= 0) "adds" else "takes away"
  if (no_change) {
    budget_text <- "the government budget is held at its share of GDP"
    if (PROJ$budget == "weo") {
      budget_text <- paste0(
        "the IMF's budget outlook ", adds_budget, " ", fmt_money(abs(last_row$budget), currency)
      )
    }
    out["Medium term"] <- paste0(
      "By ", last_row$year, ", with no growth series, ", budget_text, "."
    )
  } else {
    if (growth_source == "none") {
      growth_part <- "with no growth series, the economy is held"
    } else {
      adds_growth <- if (last_row$growth >= 0) "adds" else "takes away"
      growth_part <- paste0(
        "economic growth ", adds_growth, " ", fmt_money(abs(last_row$growth), currency)
      )
    }
    # when growth and the budget both add, the deck does not repeat "adds"
    same_way <- growth_source != "none" && last_row$growth >= 0 && last_row$budget >= 0
    if (PROJ$budget == "weo") {
      verb <- if (same_way) "" else paste0(adds_budget, " ")
      budget_part <- paste0(
        "the IMF's budget outlook ", verb, fmt_money(abs(last_row$budget), currency), " per person"
      )
    } else {
      budget_part <- "the government budget is held at its share of GDP"
    }
    compare <- ""
    if (is.finite(PROJ$comp$share_median)) {
      top_quarter <- ""
      if (is.finite(PROJ$comp$share_q3)) {
        top_quarter <- paste0(", top quarter ", num(PROJ$comp$share_q3, 1, suffix = "%"))
      }
      compare <- paste0(
        " (", ADJ, " median ", num(PROJ$comp$share_median, 1, suffix = "%"), top_quarter, ")"
      )
    }
    if (PROJ$share$capped) {
      share_part <- paste0(
        "health already takes ", num(PROJ$share$base, 1, suffix = "%"),
        " of government spending, above the ", num(PROJ$share$ceiling, 1, suffix = "%"),
        " that a quarter of countries exceed, so the share is held."
      )
    } else {
      at_ceiling <- is.finite(PROJ$share$ceiling) && last_row$share >= PROJ$share$ceiling - 1e-9
      share_part <- paste0(
        "the increase attributable to reprioritisation toward health, a share rising to ",
        num(last_row$share, 1, suffix = "%"), if (at_ceiling) ", its ceiling," else "",
        compare, ", adds ", fmt_money(last_row$prio, currency), " more."
      )
    }
    out["Medium term"] <- paste0(
      "(to ", last_row$year, "): in the Passive scenario, ", growth_part, " and ", budget_part,
      "; ", share_part
    )
  }

  # The figure: the change from the base year in each projection year, split into its three
  # parts, with the level reached after each bar
  p <- NULL
  if (!no_change) {
    bars <- proj_rows |>
      mutate(row = factor(row_labels, levels = rev(row_labels))) |>
      select(row, growth, budget, prio) |>
      pivot_longer(-row, names_to = "part", values_to = "v") |>
      mutate(
        v = v / divisor,
        part = factor(part, levels = c("prio", "budget", "growth"))
      )
    bar_ends <- data.frame(
      row = factor(row_labels, levels = rev(row_labels)),
      x = pmax(0, rowSums(pmax(parts, 0))) / divisor,
      label = level_labels
    )
    left_room <- if (min(bars$v) < 0) 0.05 else 0
    p <- ggplot(bars, aes(v, row, fill = part)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.6) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "black") +
      geom_text(
        data = bar_ends,
        aes(x, row, label = label),
        inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.1, fontface = "bold", colour = WB[["dark"]], size = 3.6
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c(growth = WB[["pale"]], budget = WB[["mid"]], prio = WB[["teal"]]),
        breaks = c("growth", "budget", "prio"),
        labels = c(
          growth = "Economic growth",
          budget = "Government budget",
          prio = "Reprioritisation (+1 point a year, illustrative)"
        )
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        labels = scales::label_comma(accuracy = 1),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(left_room, 0.25))
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Change in government health spending per person from ", base_year),
        x = axis_title,
        y = NULL
      ) +
      theme_deck()
  }
  SLIDE14[[version]] <- list(values = out, plot = p)
}

values <- SLIDE14$main$values
if (PROJ$ready && !is.null(FALLBACK_NOTE)) {
  values["Currency note"] <- FALLBACK_NOTE
}
slide_values[[14]] <- values
knitr::kable(tibble::enframe(slide_values[[14]], name = "What the slide prints", value = "Value"))
if (!is.null(SLIDE14$main$plot)) print(SLIDE14$main$plot)
```

## Slide 15. How much more funding is needed, and what would it buy?

We take both scenarios from slide 14 and value them at the last horizon. The first panel shows extra government health spending a year against 2023 spending per person held constant; the second shows deaths a cross-country spending elasticity of mortality (-0.13) would associate with higher spending; the third values those lives at full income. Each figure is illustrative: we apply a cross-country association to `r poss(SHORT)` projected deaths, with the same proportional fall at every age and no lag. The panels are not a forecast, and a costed national package would replace them.

```{r slide-15-funding-needed}
# neither scenario changes spending (within half a percent of the base level)
FLAT <- FUND$ready && all(abs(FUND$last$dg) <= 0.005 * FUND$base$ghe)

# We build slide 15 in local currency at 2023 prices, and the same slide in US$ for annex A7
# (slide 22)
SLIDE15 <- list()
versions <- if (LCU_MAIN) c("main", "annex") else "main"
for (version in versions) {
  lcu <- version == "main" && LCU_MAIN
  currency <- if (lcu) "local" else "US$"
  if (!FUND$ready) {
    message_text <- paste0(
      "Not available: the fiscal space projection for ", SHORT, " is not available, so the",
      " extra funding and what it would buy cannot be shown."
    )
    SLIDE15[[version]] <- list(values = c("Message" = message_text))
    next
  }
  base_year <- FUND$base$year
  base <- FUND$base$ghe
  last_horizon <- FUND$last # the last horizon: one row per scenario
  if (lcu) {
    rate <- to_lcu$factor[match(base_year, to_lcu$year)]
    base <- base * rate
    for (k in c("ghe", "dg", "extra", "full")) {
      last_horizon[[k]] <- last_horizon[[k]] * rate
    }
  }
  passive <- last_horizon[last_horizon$scenario == "trend", ] # scenario 1, health's share held
  reprio <- last_horizon[last_horizon$scenario == "priority", ] # scenario 2, health's share rising
  horizon_year <- last_horizon$year[1]

  # money: the change per person (and the base level), and the total a year
  per_person <- c(
    passive = fmt_money(abs(passive$dg), currency),
    reprio = fmt_money(abs(reprio$dg), currency),
    base = fmt_money(abs(base), currency)
  )
  # Totals in US$ round to two significant figures, in billions from US$1 billion and in
  # millions from US$100,000
  total <- c()
  for (k in c("passive", "reprio")) {
    amount <- if (k == "passive") abs(passive$extra) else abs(reprio$extra)
    rounded <- signif(amount, 2)
    if (!is.finite(amount)) {
      total[k] <- NA_TXT
    } else if (lcu) {
      total[k] <- fmt_money(amount)
    } else if (amount >= 1e9) {
      total[k] <- paste0("US$", num(rounded / 1e9, if (amount >= 1e10) 0 else 1), " billion")
    } else if (amount >= 1e5) {
      total[k] <- paste0("US$", num(rounded / 1e6, if (amount >= 1e6) 0 else 1), " million")
    } else {
      total[k] <- paste0("US$", num(rounded, 0))
    }
  }
  # deaths averted as printed: "under 1", the unit below 10, two significant figures above
  deaths <- abs(last_horizon$averted)
  deaths_rounded <- ifelse(deaths >= 10, signif(deaths, 2), deaths)
  deaths_text <- ifelse(deaths < 1, "under 1", num(deaths_rounded, 0))
  deaths_text[!is.finite(last_horizon$averted)] <- NA_TXT
  more_or_fewer <- ifelse(last_horizon$averted > 0, "fewer", "more")
  deaths_part <- ifelse(
    is.finite(last_horizon$averted) & deaths >= 1,
    paste0("; illustratively, about <b>", deaths_text, "</b> ", more_or_fewer, " deaths a year"),
    ""
  )
  names(deaths_part) <- c("passive", "reprio")
  flat <- all(abs(last_horizon$dg) <= 0.005 * base)
  out <- c()

  # The lead: the longest wording estimated to fit two lines, else the first within the
  # deck's limit of 192 characters
  if (abs(reprio$dg - passive$dg) <= 0.005 * base) {
    # the two scenarios end in the same place
    total_text <- if (is.finite(passive$extra)) paste0(" (<b>", total[["passive"]], "</b>)") else ""
    if (passive$dg >= 0) {
      change <- paste0("add <b>", per_person[["passive"]], "</b> a person a year over ", base_year)
    } else {
      change <- paste0(
        "leave spending <b>", per_person[["passive"]], "</b> a person a year below ", base_year
      )
    }
    both_end <- paste0("By <b>", horizon_year, "</b>, both scenarios would ", change, total_text)
    options <- c(
      paste0(both_end, ": health's budget share is already high", deaths_part[["passive"]], "."),
      paste0(both_end, deaths_part[["passive"]], "."),
      paste0(both_end, ".")
    )
    if (flat) {
      lead <- paste0(
        "By <b>", horizon_year, "</b>, neither scenario changes government health spending",
        " per person from its ", base_year, " level (<b>", per_person[["base"]],
        "</b>), so there is no extra funding to value."
      )
    } else {
      short_enough <- which(nchar(gsub("<[^>]+>", "", options)) <= 192)
      lead <- options[c(short_enough, length(options))[1]]
    }
  } else {
    total_text <- if (is.finite(reprio$extra)) paste0(" (<b>", total[["reprio"]], "</b>)") else ""
    against <- paste0(
      ", against ", if (passive$dg < 0) "a fall of " else "", "<b>", per_person[["passive"]],
      "</b> in the Passive scenario"
    )
    rise <- reprio$dg >= 0
    if (rise) {
      adds <- paste0("adds <b>", per_person[["reprio"]], "</b> a person a year over ", base_year)
    } else {
      adds <- paste0(
        "leaves spending <b>", per_person[["reprio"]], "</b> a person a year below ", base_year
      )
    }
    reprioritisation <- paste0("illustrative reprioritisation ", adds, total_text, against)
    options <- c(
      paste0(
        "By <b>", horizon_year, "</b> (medium-term outlook), ", reprioritisation,
        deaths_part[["reprio"]], "."
      ),
      paste0("By <b>", horizon_year, "</b>, ", reprioritisation, deaths_part[["reprio"]], "."),
      paste0("By <b>", horizon_year, "</b>, ", reprioritisation, ".")
    )
    # two lines at 27 px: in US$ bold figures count wider too, and the margin is 8% (6% in
    # local currency)
    widths <- sapply(options, lead_width, bold_figures_wider = !lcu)
    fitting <- options[widths <= 2 * 1380 * (if (lcu) 0.94 else 0.92)]
    add <- paste0(
      if (rise) "add " else "leave spending ", "<b>", per_person[["reprio"]], "</b> a person a year"
    )
    over_or_below <- paste0(if (rise) " over " else " below ", base_year)
    prioritising <- paste0("By <b>", horizon_year, "</b>, prioritising health would ", add)
    fallback <- c(
      paste0(prioritising, over_or_below, total_text, against, deaths_part[["reprio"]], "."),
      paste0(prioritising, total_text, against, deaths_part[["reprio"]], "."),
      paste0(prioritising, over_or_below, total_text, against, ".")
    )
    if (length(fitting) > 0) {
      lead <- fitting[1]
    } else {
      short_enough <- which(nchar(gsub("<[^>]+>", "", fallback)) <= 192)
      lead <- fallback[c(short_enough, length(fallback))[1]]
    }
  }
  out["Lead"] <- gsub("<[^>]+>", "", lead) # the bold marks only served the width estimate

  # the two scenario cards
  base_share <- FUND$share0
  out["Card 1"] <- paste0("health's budget share stays at ", num(base_share, 1, suffix = "%"))
  growth_source <- PROJ$growth$source
  out["Card 1 assumption"] <- case_when(
    growth_source == "weo" & PROJ$budget == "weo" ~
      "the economy and the budget follow IMF projections",
    growth_source == "weo" ~
      paste0("IMF growth; the budget stays at its ", base_year, " share of GDP"),
    growth_source == "past" & PROJ$budget == "weo" ~
      "past growth continues; the budget follows the IMF",
    growth_source == "past" ~
      "past growth continues; the budget keeps its share of GDP",
    TRUE ~ "no growth series: the economy is held at its base level"
  )
  if (FUND$capped) {
    out["Card 2"] <- paste0(
      "health's budget share, ", num(base_share, 1, suffix = "%"),
      ", is above the world top quarter (",
      num(FUND$ceiling, 1, suffix = "%"), ")"
    )
  } else {
    out["Card 2"] <- paste0(
      "health's budget share, ", num(base_share, 1, suffix = "%"), " in ", base_year, " to ",
      num(reprio$share, 1, suffix = "%"), " in ", horizon_year
    )
    step <- if (is.finite(FUND$step) && FUND$step > 0) FUND$step else NA_real_
    at_ceiling <- is.finite(FUND$ceiling) && is.finite(reprio$share) &&
      reprio$share >= FUND$ceiling - 1e-6
    if (at_ceiling) {
      out["Card 2 assumption"] <- paste0(
        "capped at ", num(FUND$ceiling, 1, suffix = "%"), ", the world top quarter"
      )
    } else if (is.finite(step)) {
      step_digits <- if (abs(step - round(step)) < 0.05) 0 else 1
      points_word <- if (abs(step - 1) < 0.05) " point" else " points"
      from_year <- if (PROJ$start > base_year) paste0(" from ", PROJ$start + 1) else ""
      out["Card 2 assumption"] <- paste0(
        "+", num(step, step_digits), points_word, " a year", from_year
      )
    }
  }

  # The three panels: extra spending, deaths averted and the value of those lives, in a unit
  # that suits their size
  biggest <- max(0, abs(c(last_horizon$extra, last_horizon$full)), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (lcu) {
    divisor <- case_when(
      biggest >= 1e12 ~ 1e12,
      biggest >= 1e9 ~ 1e9,
      biggest >= 1e6 ~ 1e6,
      TRUE ~ 1
    )
    unit_word <- case_when(
      divisor == 1e12 ~ " trillion",
      divisor == 1e9 ~ " billion",
      divisor == 1e6 ~ " million",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
    unit <- paste0(CODE, unit_word)
  } else {
    divisor <- if (biggest >= 1e11) 1e9 else 1e6
    unit <- paste("US$", if (divisor == 1e9) "billion" else "million")
  }
  # The panel amounts as printed (extra spending, then the value of lives, each for scenarios
  # 1 and 2): the chart's rounding in local currency; in US$ millions or billions, two
  # significant figures (one below 0.1)
  amounts <- c(last_horizon$extra, last_horizon$full) / divisor
  if (lcu) {
    amount_text <- case_when(
      abs(amounts) >= 10 ~ num(amounts, 0),
      abs(amounts) >= 1 ~ num(amounts, 1),
      TRUE ~ num(amounts, 2)
    )
  } else {
    amount_text <- case_when(
      abs(amounts) >= 10 ~ num(signif(amounts, 2), 0),
      abs(amounts) >= 1 ~ num(signif(amounts, 2), 1),
      abs(amounts) >= 0.095 ~ num(signif(amounts, 1), 1),
      abs(amounts) >= 0.01 ~ num(signif(amounts, 1), 2),
      TRUE ~ "0"
    )
  }
  amount_text[!is.finite(amounts)] <- NA_TXT
  if (flat) {
    no_growth <- if (PROJ$growth$source == "none") ": no growth projection is available" else ""
    already_high <- ""
    if (FUND$capped) {
      already_high <- paste0(
        ", and health already takes ", num(base_share, 1, suffix = "%"),
        " of government spending, above the world top quarter"
      )
    }
    out["No change"] <- paste0(
      "Neither path raises government health spending per person by ", horizon_year, no_growth,
      already_high, "."
    )
  } else {
    for (i in 1:2) {
      name <- paste("Scenario", i)
      out[paste("Extra spending,", name)] <- amount_text[i]
      if (FUND$health_ready) {
        minus <- if (isTRUE(last_horizon$averted[i] <= -1)) "-" else ""
        out[paste("Deaths averted,", name)] <- paste0(minus, deaths_text[i])
      }
      if (FUND$value_ready) {
        out[paste("Value of lives,", name)] <- amount_text[i + 2]
      }
    }
    out["Panel unit"] <- paste0(
      "Extra government health spending in ", horizon_year, ", ", unit, " a year"
    )
    out["Deaths panel"] <- paste0("Deaths averted in ", horizon_year, ", illustrative")
    prices_note <- if (lcu) {
      paste0("; ", CUR_NAME, " at ", BASE, " prices (", RATE_TEXT, ")")
    } else {
      paste0(", US$ of ", base_year)
    }
    out["Figure note"] <- paste0(
      "Against ", base_year, " government health spending per person held constant", prices_note
    )
  }

  # The figure: the three panels, scenario 1 in grey and scenario 2 in blue
  p <- NULL
  if (!FLAT) {
    panel_titles <- c(
      extra = paste0("Extra government health spending, ", unit, " a year"),
      averted = "Deaths averted, illustrative",
      full = paste0("Value of those lives, ", unit, " a year")
    )
    panel_bars <- data.frame(
      panel = factor(rep(panel_titles, each = 2), levels = panel_titles),
      scen = rep(c("Scenario 1", "Scenario 2"), 3),
      v = c(last_horizon$extra / divisor, last_horizon$averted, last_horizon$full / divisor),
      lab = c(amount_text[1:2], deaths_text, amount_text[3:4])
    )
    panel_bars <- panel_bars[is.finite(panel_bars$v), ]
    bottom_room <- if (any(panel_bars$v < 0, na.rm = TRUE)) 0.12 else 0
    p <- ggplot(panel_bars, aes(scen, v, fill = scen)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.55) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "black") +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = lab, vjust = ifelse(v >= 0, -0.4, 1.4)),
        fontface = "bold", size = 3.6
      ) +
      facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3, labeller = label_wrap_gen(28)) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("Scenario 1" = WB[["grey"]], "Scenario 2" = WB[["teal"]]),
        guide = "none"
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = scales::label_comma(accuracy = 1),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(bottom_room, 0.15))
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(
          "In ", horizon_year, ", against ", base_year, " spending per person held constant"
        ),
        x = NULL,
        y = NULL
      ) +
      theme_deck(11)
  }
  SLIDE15[[version]] <- list(values = out, plot = p)
}

values <- SLIDE15$main$values
if (FUND$ready && !FLAT && !is.null(FALLBACK_NOTE)) {
  values["Currency note"] <- FALLBACK_NOTE
}
slide_values[[15]] <- values
knitr::kable(tibble::enframe(slide_values[[15]], name = "What the slide prints", value = "Value"))
if (!is.null(SLIDE15$main$plot)) print(SLIDE15$main$plot)
```

## Slide 16. Annex A1. What is the main performance gap: health, financial protection, or both?

We plot each country's health score (slide 5) against its protection score (slide 6), both in standard deviations from the level typical at the country's spending, with right and up better. A score at or below -0.5 is a gap, dividing the chart into no gap, health gap only, protection gap only, or both. On the main slide, both scores come from the PPP fits. The scores use different fits and often different years, so the chart shows where gaps are, not which is larger.

```{r slide-16-annex-a1-performance-gap}
# The main slide uses the PPP scores, unless the country has a protection score only at
# market exchange rates
usd_protection_only <- is.finite(GAP_USD$protection$z) && !is.finite(GAP_PPP$protection$z)
A1_PPP <- LCU_MAIN && isTRUE(HEALTH_PPP$ready) && !usd_protection_only
gap_fit <- if (A1_PPP) GAP_PPP else GAP_USD
health_fit <- if (A1_PPP) HEALTH_PPP else HEALTH_USD
protection_fit <- if (A1_PPP) PROT_PPP else PROT_USD
health_z <- gap_fit$health$z
protection_z <- gap_fit$protection$z

# scores print to two decimals with a sign; one that rounds to zero prints as 0.00
health_text <- NULL
if (is.finite(health_z)) {
  health_text <- paste0("health ", num(health_z, 2, plus = TRUE), " (", gap_fit$health$year, ")")
}
protection_text <- NULL
if (is.finite(protection_z)) {
  protection_text <- paste0(
    "protection ", num(protection_z, 2, plus = TRUE), " (survey ", gap_fit$protection$year, ")"
  )
}

# why a score is missing
if (is.na(protection_fit$country$measure)) {
  no_protection <- "no household survey of health costs is published"
} else if (!is.finite(protection_fit$country$spending)) {
  no_protection <- paste0(
    "the ", protection_fit$country$year,
    " survey has no government health spending figure for its year"
  )
} else {
  no_protection <- "too few countries have a survey to compare with"
}
if (!isTRUE(health_fit$ready)) {
  no_health <- "too few countries publish spending and outcomes for the same year"
} else {
  no_health <- "fewer than two of premature NCD, under-five and maternal mortality are published"
}

out <- c()
if (gap_fit$gap == "both") {
  out["Lead"] <- paste0(
    "A gap in both: ", health_text, " and ", protection_text, " are 0.5 standard deviations",
    " or more below the level typical at the country's spending."
  )
} else if (gap_fit$gap == "health" && !is.null(protection_text)) {
  out["Lead"] <- paste0(
    "The gap is in health: ", health_text, " is below the -0.5 line; ", protection_text,
    " is not."
  )
} else if (gap_fit$gap == "health") {
  out["Lead"] <- paste0(
    "The gap is in health (", health_text, "); financial protection has no score."
  )
} else if (gap_fit$gap == "protection" && !is.null(health_text)) {
  out["Lead"] <- paste0(
    "The gap is in financial protection: ", protection_text, " is below the -0.5 line; ",
    health_text, " is not."
  )
} else if (gap_fit$gap == "protection") {
  out["Lead"] <- paste0(
    "The gap is in financial protection (", protection_text, "); health has no score."
  )
} else if (gap_fit$gap == "neither") {
  out["Lead"] <- paste0(
    "No gap: neither ", health_text, " nor ", protection_text, " is 0.5 standard deviations",
    " or more below the level typical at the country's spending."
  )
} else if (!is.null(health_text)) {
  # one score only, or none
  health_words <- case_when(
    health_z >= 0.5 ~ "better than typical",
    health_z <= -0.5 ~ "worse than typical",
    TRUE ~ "close to typical"
  )
  out["Lead"] <- paste0(
    "Health is ", health_words, " (", health_text, "), but financial protection has no",
    " score: ", no_protection, "."
  )
} else if (!is.null(protection_text)) {
  protection_words <- case_when(
    protection_z >= 0.5 ~ "stronger than typical",
    protection_z <= -0.5 ~ "weaker than typical",
    TRUE ~ "close to typical"
  )
  out["Lead"] <- paste0(
    "Financial protection is ", protection_words, " (", protection_text,
    "), but health has no score: ", no_health, "."
  )
} else {
  out["Lead"] <- paste0(
    "Neither score can be computed: for health, ", no_health, "; for protection, ",
    no_protection, "."
  )
}
counts <- gap_fit$counts
if (counts[["n"]] > 0) {
  out["Count: health gap only"] <- paste("Health gap only:", counts[["health"]])
  out["Count: gap in both"] <- paste("Gap in both:", counts[["both"]])
  out["Count: protection gap only"] <- paste("Protection gap only:", counts[["protection"]])
  out["Count: no gap"] <- paste("No gap:", counts[["neither"]])
}
out["Countries with both scores"] <- paste0(
  "Each dot is a country with both scores (", counts[["n"]], ")"
)
if (A1_PPP) {
  out["Slides of the two fits"] <- paste0("(slides ", POS[["q01"]], " and ", POS[["q02"]], ")")
}
group_counts <- gap_fit$group_counts
if (group_counts[["n"]] > 0) {
  out["Income group"] <- paste0(
    "Of ", group_counts[["n"]], " ", ADJ, " countries with both scores, ",
    group_counts[["neither"]], " have no gap, ", group_counts[["health"]], " a health gap, ",
    group_counts[["protection"]], " a protection gap and ", group_counts[["both"]], " both."
  )
}
slide_values[[16]] <- out
knitr::kable(tibble::enframe(slide_values[[16]], name = "What the slide prints", value = "Value"))

# The figure: every country's health score against its protection score, with the -0.5 lines
if (nrow(gap_fit$points) > 0) {
  scatter_points <- mutate(gap_fit$points, peer = iso %in% gap_fit$peers$iso)
  labels <- scatter_points |>
    filter(peer) |>
    transmute(h, p, label = countries$label[match(iso, ISOS)], face = "plain")
  corner_labels <- c(
    paste("Health gap only:", counts[["health"]]),
    paste("No gap:", counts[["neither"]]),
    paste("Gap in both:", counts[["both"]]),
    paste("Protection gap only:", counts[["protection"]])
  )
  p <- ggplot(scatter_points, aes(h, p)) +
    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = -Inf, xmax = -0.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
      fill = WB[["rust"]], alpha = 0.06
    ) +
    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = -0.5,
      fill = WB[["rust"]], alpha = 0.06
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = WB[["rust"]]) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = WB[["rust"]]) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = peer), size = 1.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(`FALSE` = WB[["faint"]], `TRUE` = WB[["muted"]]),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = c(-Inf, Inf, -Inf, Inf), y = c(Inf, Inf, -Inf, -Inf),
      hjust = c(-0.05, 1.05, -0.05, 1.05), vjust = c(1.5, 1.5, -0.8, -0.8),
      label = corner_labels,
      colour = c(WB[["rust"]], WB[["muted"]], WB[["rust"]], WB[["rust"]]),
      family = "Open Sans", fontface = "bold", size = 3.4
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Health score against protection score",
      subtitle = paste(
        "Standard deviations from the level typical at each country's spending;",
        "right and up are better"
      ),
      x = "Health score (right is better)",
      y = "Protection score"
    ) +
    theme_deck()
  if (is.finite(health_z) && is.finite(protection_z)) {
    p <- p + annotate("point", x = health_z, y = protection_z, colour = WB[["teal"]], size = 4.5)
    own_label <- data.frame(h = health_z, p = protection_z, label = SHORT, face = "bold")
    labels <- bind_rows(labels, own_label)
  }
  p + geom_text_repel(
    data = labels,
    aes(h, p, label = label, fontface = face),
    family = "Open Sans", size = 3.3, colour = WB[["dark"]],
    box.padding = 0.6, min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1
  )
}
```

# Check against the deck

For the fifteen reference countries, we use `data/reference_slides.rds`, which holds the visible text of every slide as printed in the deck's own HTML export. We check both ways. First, every value in the tables above must appear in its slide's text as a whole number: "23" does not count as found inside "2023". Second, after removing those values, no number may remain in the slide text except in the deck's fixed wording (source lines, definitions and stated rules, such as "ages 30 to 70" or "more than 5% below"); this catches any number the file does not compute. We set aside axis tick labels when building the reference because the plotting library draws them as scale marks, not computed numbers. The chunk stops with an error on any mismatch.

```{r reference-check}
REF <- readRDS(file.path("data", "reference_slides.rds"))

# Text as we compare it: one space for any run of spaces, and no space before punctuation
# (bold text leaves one in the deck's export)
norm_space <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(gsub("[[:space:]\u00a0\u2009\u202f]+", " ", x))
  x <- gsub(" ([.,;:)])", "\\1", x)
  gsub("\\( ", "(", x)
}
# The deck's fixed wording that carries digits: we mask it in the slide text and in the values
# alike
TEMPLATE <- c(
  "\\(2025 update\\)", "\\(2025\\)", "2025 definition", "UHC global monitoring report 2025",
  "World Bank \\(2025\\)", "ages 30 to 70", "SDG 3\\.8\\.2", "SDG indicator 3\\.b\\.3",
  "SH\\.DYN\\.NCOM\\.ZS", "HC\\.5\\.1", "SHA 2011", "per 1,000 births", "(?i)per 1,000 people",
  "per 1,000 adults", "per 100,000 births", "per 100,000", "per 1,000 at risk", "per 1,000\\b",
  "\\(0 to 100\\)", "constant 2023", "2023 prices", "2023 PPP", "October 2026", "August 2026",
  "Workforce 2030 \\(2016\\)", "SDG health targets \\(2016\\)",
  "World Population Prospects 2024", "Medicine 2017", "Global health 2050 \\(2024\\)",
  "Heller \\(2006\\)", "Tandon and Cashin \\(2010\\)", "Barroy and Gupta \\(2020\\)",
  "\\(draft, 2026\\)", "more than 5%", "more than 10%", "\\+1 point", "up 1 point",
  "dashed line = 100%", "25th to 75th percentile", "CC[ A-Z-]* [0-9.]+", "160 times",
  "\\(-0\\.13\\)", "age 75", "(?i)scenario [12]", "WHO threshold of 4\\.45", "-0\\.5",
  "0\\.5 standard deviations", "1\u00d7", "\\b[0-9]+/[0-9]+\\b", "next one to two",
  "\\bA[1-7]\\b", "2020 to 2022 include COVID-19", "more than 10 points",
  paste0(
    "(?<![0-9.])[1-4]\\. (Fiscal size and trend|Health spending efficiency|",
    "Health budget execution|Fiscal space projection)"
  ),
  "5 points or more", "25% or more and 10 points", "gaps under 5 points count as 5", "DTP3",
  "more than 10% of their budget", "over 10% of the household budget",
  "The 2025 hardship measure", "the older 10% measure", "over 10% of budget"
)
mask <- function(x) {
  for (pattern in TEMPLATE) {
    x <- gsub(pattern, "\u00a7", x, perl = TRUE)
  }
  x
}
# A value counts as found only as a whole number: "23" is not found inside "2023" or "23.5"
value_pattern <- function(value) {
  before <- if (grepl("^[-+]?[0-9]", value)) "(?<![0-9.,])" else ""
  after <- if (grepl("[0-9]$", value)) "(?![0-9]|[.,][0-9])" else ""
  paste0(before, "\\Q", value, "\\E", after)
}

CHECK <- NULL
if (!ISO %in% REF$iso3) {
  cat(
    "No reference text is stored for ", NAME, ": the check runs only for the fifteen ",
    "reference countries (", paste(unique(REF$iso3), collapse = ", "), ").\n",
    sep = ""
  )
} else {
  ref_country <- filter(REF, iso3 == ISO)
  check_rows <- list()
  for (n in seq_len(N_SLIDES)) {
    slide_text <- norm_space(ref_country$text[ref_country$slide == n])
    values <- norm_space(slide_values[[n]])
    # First, every value must appear in the text of its slide
    found <- logical(length(values))
    for (i in seq_along(values)) {
      found[i] <- grepl(value_pattern(values[i]), slide_text, perl = TRUE)
    }
    # Second, once the values and the fixed wording are taken out, no number may be left
    # (we drop the page number in the footer first)
    rest <- sub("\u00b7 [0-9]+ / [0-9]+$", "", slide_text)
    rest <- mask(rest)
    for (value in values[order(-nchar(values))]) {
      rest <- gsub(value_pattern(mask(value)), " ", rest, perl = TRUE)
    }
    number_matches <- gregexpr("[-+]?[0-9][0-9,]*(\\.[0-9]+)?", rest)
    left <- unlist(regmatches(rest, number_matches))
    check_rows[[n]] <- data.frame(
      Slide = n,
      `Values checked` = length(values),
      `Not found in the deck` = sum(!found),
      `Deck numbers not reproduced` = length(left),
      Result = if (all(found) && length(left) == 0) "pass" else "FAIL",
      Detail = paste(c(values[!found], left), collapse = " | "),
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  }
  CHECK <- bind_rows(check_rows)
}
if (!is.null(CHECK)) knitr::kable(CHECK, align = "rrrrll")
if (!is.null(CHECK)) {
  cat(
    sum(CHECK$`Values checked`), "values on", nrow(CHECK), "slides;",
    sum(CHECK$Result == "pass"), "slides pass.\n"
  )
  if (any(CHECK$Result != "pass")) {
    stop(
      "The numbers of ", sum(CHECK$Result != "pass"),
      " slide(s) do not match the deck's text for ", ISO, "."
    )
  }
}
```
